name: Amber Earrings
description: One of the items sold by the Gerudo jeweler. These earrings are made with amber, a gem that harnesses the power of the land to increase defense when equipped.
obtained_zh:
琥珀耳环是一种配饰，特别是可以佩戴在林克耳朵上的耳环。可在格鲁多镇的“星光回忆珠宝店”购买，价格为100卢比和十块琥珀。这些琥珀耳环能够吸收土地的力量，使其防御力高于大多数其他盔甲。
在大型仙女之泉处，可以通过大型仙女升级琥珀耳环。但它们不能在科奇染料店染色。这些耳环的主要用途是提升林克的防御力。
description_zh: 陈列在格鲁德珠宝店里的经典商品之一。使用蕴含大地之力量的宝石琥珀所制成的耳坠。装备后因其加护，防御力会增加。

name: Ancient Hero's Aspect
description: This item is said to contain the spirit of a hero who once saved Hyrule. That hero's aura will envelop the wearer.
obtained:
The Ancient Hero's Aspect is a piece of Armor and an Armor Set. It is obtained from the Treasure Chest that appears behind the Goddess Statue in the Temple of Time as part of the "The Shrine Explorer" Side Quest. The Quest begins when Link receives the final Light of Blessing after completing every Shrine of Light. 
Unlike other Armor, the Ancient Hero's Aspect is by itself a complete Armor Set and cannot be worn alongside any other pieces of Armor; the Rupee cost to upgrade it is tripled (30, 150, 600, 1500) due to this. When the Ancient Hero's Aspect has been upgraded at least two times by a Great Fairy and is worn, it provides the Master Sword Beam Up Set Bonus.
obtained_zh:
“古老英雄”套装是盔甲和一套盔甲。可以通过在时间神殿女神雕像后出现的宝箱中获得，作为“神殿探险家”支线的任务奖励。任务开始于链接完成所有光之神龛后获得最终的神圣祝福。

与其它盔甲不同，“古老英雄”套装本身就是一套完整的盔甲，不能与其他盔甲组合使用；升级所需的卢比成本翻倍（30, 150, 600, 1500），这是因为如此。当“古老英雄”套装被强大的精灵至少升级两次后佩戴时，即可获得“贤者之剑光束提升”套装加成。
description_zh: 传说曾经拯救过海拉鲁的勇者之魂。将此灵魂附于身上，可以身缠灵气，并使外貌变成其模样。

name: Archaic Tunic
description: Old-fashioned upper-body wear. It's got some holes, but the soft cloth feels good to the touch. It's hard to keep it wrinkle-free.
obtained: The Archaic Tunic can be found in a Stone Chest near the east entrance of Pondside Cave on the Great Sky Island. It can later be repurchased from Cece at Ventest Clothing Boutique in Hateno Village. It can be Dyed at the Kochi Dye Shop, but cannot be enhanced by the Great Fairies.
obtained_zh: 古老的长袍可在“大天空岛”上坡侧洞穴东入口附近的石箱中找到。稍后可从 “哈特诺村” 的 “文特斯服装店” 中的塞塞处购买。可在 “高基染料店” 进行染色，但无法通过 “伟大仙灵” 强化。
description_zh: 样式古老的外衣。虽然有些开绽，但柔滑的触感很舒服。上面的褶皱很难抚平。

name: Archaic Legwear
description: Simple, classic legwear. They're well-worn and showing their age, but they've still got a few good years left in them. It can be a bit cumbersome to have to tie the straps.
obtained: Great Sky Island
obtained_zh: 伟大的天空岛
description_zh: 简朴的老式鞋。虽然有些颇具年代感的破损，但穿起来完全没问题。凉拖的带子有些难系。

name: Archaic Warm Greaves
description: Warm greaves believed to be from a very long time ago. Despite the old look, the heat-retaining material makes it pleasantly resistant to cold temperatures.
obtained_zh: 初始空岛（伟大的天空岛）雪山区域：古特安巴克神庙东北方的空心树洞内宝箱。
description_zh: 看起来制作年代相当久远的防寒服。虽然有些陈旧，但料子保温性很好，因此足够抵御一定程度的寒冷。

name: Barbarian Helm
description: A helmet once worn by the warriors of an ancient warlike tribe from the Faron region.
obtained_zh: 《野蛮人头盔》：一件位于洛梅迷宫岛的图卡罗神殿中的盔甲。获得后，格兰特会以4000卢比的价格出售。据描述，这顶头盔是来自法隆地区古老而凶猛部落战士所戴的。佩戴时提供1点攻击力提升。《野蛮人头盔》可由大仙女强化，并在科奇染料店染色。与《野蛮人盔甲》和《野蛮人护腿》一起，《野蛮人套装》构成完整装备。《野蛮人套装》每件装备至少强化两次，且全身佩戴时，可以获得“攻击·体能提升”效果。
description_zh: 据说是太古时代居住在费罗尼地区的战斗部族的头盔。刻在上面的古老花纹能够鼓舞佩戴者的精神，增加攻击力。

name: Barbarian Armor
description: Armor once favored by an ancient warlike tribe from the Faron region.
obtained: The Barbarian Armor is found in a Treasure Chest in Crenel Hills Cave.[verification needed]
obtained_zh: 野蛮人盔甲在克雷尔山丘洞穴中的宝箱中可以找到。[需要验证]
description_zh: 据说是很久以前以费罗尼地区为据点的战斗部族的服装。穿上后因刻在上面的特殊花纹，会激发斗志，增加攻击力。

name: Barbarian Leg Wraps
description: Leg wraps once favored by a warlike tribe. The traditional design bolsters your fighting spirit to raise your strength.
obtained_zh: 蛮荒护腿位于北洛梅迷宫中心，在卡扎托基神殿内。获得后，格兰特会以4000卢比的价格出售该护腿。根据描述，这些护腿由来自法隆地区的古代部落战士所穿。穿着后，为林克提供1级的攻击力加成。蛮荒护腿可以被大精灵增强，并在科奇染色店进行染色。 蛮荒护腿、蛮荒头盔和蛮荒装甲等共同构成“蛮荒套装”。当每个套装的部件都至少被大精灵增强两次，并且完整套装穿着时，则提供充能攻击力加成（Charge Atk.）和体能+的 bonus。
description_zh: 据说是很久以前居住在费罗尼地区的战斗部族的短裤，穿着者因上面的特殊花纹，会激发斗志，增加攻击力。

name: Bokoblin Mask
description: Kilton's handmade Bokoblin headgear. It's almost charming in a cute, monstrous kind of way... Equip it to blend in with Bokoblins.
obtained: The Bokoblin Mask returns in Tears of the Kingdom, functioning the same as it did in Breath of the Wild. It can be obtained from Koltin as a reward for completing the Side Adventure "The Hunt for Bubbul Gems!". Subsequent Bokoblin Masks can be purchased from Cece for 4000 Rupees.
obtained_zh: 在《泪之王国》中，“博科布林面具”回归。其功能与《塞尔达传说：旷野之息》中的相同。可从柯尔廷处获得，作为完成“寻找巴布卢宝石”支线任务的奖励。后续的博科布林面具可在塞塞处购买，价格为 4000 鲁比。
description_zh: 吉尔顿亲手制作的波克布林面罩。做得相当可爱。戴上之后，很难被波克布林发现。

name: Cap of Time
description: According to legend, this cap was once worn by a hero who traveled through time. A truly timeless item perfect for kids and adults alike!
obtained: Sturnida Lavafalls
obtained_zh: 斯图尼达瀑布
description_zh: 据说是穿越时空而来的勇者所佩戴的帽子。无论是小孩还是大人都想戴的精品。

name: Cap of Twilight
description: According to legend, this cap was worn by a hero who battled the creatures of twilight.
obtained: The Cap of Twilight is found inside a Stone Chest in the Gleeok Den in the Akkala Highlands Depths. This Stone Chest is covered in Gloom and cannot be opened until the Gloom-Wreathed King Gleeok in the Den is defeated.
obtained_zh: 在阿卡拉高原深处的格利奥克谷内，有一个石箱。石箱内有“暮光之帽”，但需要先击败谷内的“雾蒙笼罩的国王格利奥克”才能打开它。
description_zh: 据说是和黄昏怪物战斗的勇者所佩戴的帽子。不知为何，有股野兽的臭味。

name: Cap of the Hero
description: According to legend, this cap was once treasured by an ancient hero.
obtained: Tuft Canyon Mine
obtained_zh: 图夫峡谷矿山
description_zh: 据说是古代勇者爱戴的帽子。虽说制作简单，但也是其魅力所在的一款精品。

name: Cap of the Sky
description: According to legend, this cap was once worn by a hero who appeared from the sky riding a mighty bird.
obtained: Retsam Grove
obtained_zh: 列萨姆谷
description_zh: 据说是乘着大鸟从空中出现的勇者经常戴着的帽子。是一顶适合空中飞行时佩戴的精品。

name: Cap of the Wild
description: According to legend, this cap was crafted for a hero who travels the wildlands.
obtained_zh:
《旷野之息》

“野之帽”是一件可以从“僧侣们的礼物”支线任务中获得的盔甲。 完成所有120个古代神殿（不包括需在主线任务“勇者赞歌”中完成的16个神殿），最后一位僧侣会告诉林克前往遗忘寺，在那里他会在寺庙后方的母亲女神雕像前找到三个石箱。 中间的箱子内装有“野之帽”。 “野之帽”可以被大仙娘强化，并在 Kochi 染色店进行染色。 “野之帽”、“野之斗篷”和“野之裤”组成“勇者之套装”。 当每个部件都由大仙娘强化至少两次，并且整个套装佩戴时，会获得“贤者之剑”效果提升。

《王国之泪》
description_zh: 据说是为旷野之旅的勇者量身定做的帽子。不知为何，总觉得戴着特别合适。

name: Cap of the Wind
description: According to legend, this cap was treasured by a hero who sailed the Great Sea.
obtained:
The Cap of the Wind can be obtained from a Treasure Chest in the southernmost cavern below the Tingel Island Chasm in the Akkala Highlands Depths or by using the amiibo Ancient Power.
The Cap of the Wind, alongside the Tunic of the Wind and Trousers of the Wind, comprises the Of the Wind Set which resembles Link's outfit from The Wind Waker.
obtained_zh:
风帽可以通过在阿卡拉高原深处，丁格尔岛峡谷下方最南端的洞穴中的宝箱获得，也可以通过使用 amiibo 古代力量获得。

风帽、风衣和风裤是“风之套装”，外观与《海拉鲁王子》中的林克服装相似。
description_zh: 据说是在大海上旅行的勇者爱戴的帽子。经常随着柔和的海风飘动。

name: Cece's Hat
description: An avant-garde masterpiece designed by Cece. Guaranteed to make the fashionistas' heads turn.
obtained: Ventest Clothing Boutique
description_zh: 由Cece设计的超前卫杰作。保证能让时尚达人眼前一亮。
obtained_zh: 温特斯服装精品店

name: Champion's Leathers
description: This garment, worn by those in good standing with Hyrule royalty, has been reworked with the latest improvements, such as a new shoulder guard.
effect: Grants Link the ability to shoot sword beams with the Master Sword without full health
obtained:
The Champion's Leathers serve as a replacement for the Champion's Tunic, which is destroyed during Link and Zelda's encounter with Ganondorf Beneath Hyrule Castle. Upon reading Zelda's Diary in her Secret Well in Hateno Village, Link learns that she was planning to surprise him with the Champion's Leathers, having noticed that his original Tunic had become worn during their travels. To keep the Leathers a secret, she hid them in the Throne Room of Hyrule Castle, with a pair of Torches being the key to reveal them. Reading this Book starts the "A New Champion's Tunic" Side Quest. When Link lights both of the Torches in the Throne Room, the statue behind the thrones will shift to the side, revealing a metallic Treasure Chest inside its pedestal. Upon opening the Chest, Link will receive the Champion's Leathers.
When worn, the Champion's Leathers gives Link the effect Master Sword Beam Always Available, allowing him to shoot sword beams from the Master Sword regardless of current hit points. The Champion's Leathers has the highest potential defense of any Armor present in the game, with a maximum defense of 32.
obtained_zh:
“冠军的皮革”是“冠军的短衫”的替代品，在林克和塞尔达与加农多夫在海拉鲁城堡下方的遭遇中，“冠军的短衫”被摧毁。通过在哈特诺村的秘密井中阅读塞尔达的日记，林克得知她计划将“冠军的皮革”作为惊喜送给他，因为他发现原本的“冠军的短衫”已经磨损了。为了保密，她将“冠军的皮革”藏在海拉鲁城堡的王座室，而两根火炬是打开它们的关键。阅读这本书会启动“新的冠军的短衫”支线任务。当林克点燃王座室中的两根火炬时，“王座后的雕像”会向侧移动，露出它底部的金属宝箱。打开宝箱后，林克将获得“冠军的皮革”。

穿着“冠军的皮革”，林克可以获得“大师之剑光可用的效果”，“无论当前的生命值如何，都可以从大师之剑上发射剑光”。 “冠军的皮革”具有游戏中最强的防御力，最大防御值为32。
description_zh: 受海拉鲁王族认可的英杰所穿衣服的最新款。以旧款为基础，进行了增加护肩等使其更适合冒险时穿着的改良。

name: Charged Headdress
description: Used in ancient rituals and made from conductive material, this item produces electricity during thunderstorms.
obtained: Dracozu River
obtained_zh: ドラコズ川
description_zh: 据推测是很久以前用于祭祀活动的头饰。利用带电性很高的材料的特性，能从雷雨天的大气中释放雷电攻击。

name: Charged Shirt
description: Used in ancient rituals and made from conductive material, this item produces electricity during thunderstorms.
obtained: Dracozu River
obtained_zh: ドラコズ川
description_zh: 据推测是很久以前为祭祀活动缝制的衣服。由于布料具有很高的带电性，雷雨时可以收集四周的电力释放雷电攻击。

name: Charged Trousers
description: Used in ancient rituals and made from conductive material, this item produces electricity during thunderstorms.
obtained: Dracozu River
obtained_zh: 德拉科朱河
description_zh: 据推测是古代祭祀活动时使用的裤子。由具备很高带电性的布料制成，雷雨时可以利用空气中的电力释放雷电攻击。

name: Climber's Bandana
description: This bandanna uses ancient technology that enhances core strength to improve your climbing ability.
obtained: Ploymus Mountain Cave
description_zh: 这块头巾采用古老技术，增强核心力量，从而提高攀岩能力。
obtained_zh: 普洛姆斯山洞

name: Climbing Boots
description: The ancient technology used in making this gear and its no-slip glove will make you a better climber.
obtained_zh: 攀岩靴位于兰奈鲁山上的塔诺·奥亚神殿。获得后，格兰特会以4000卢比的价格出售。根据描述，这双靴子融合了古代科技。佩戴时，提供一次“攀爬速度提升”。攀岩靴可以被大妖精增强，并在高奇染料店染色。与攀岩头巾和攀岩装备一起，构成“攀岩套装”。当每件物品被大妖精增强至少两次，并穿上完整套装时，会获得“攀岩跳跃耐力提升”的额外效果。
description_zh: 采用古代技术制成的登墙用的鞋子。使用了防滑性佳的材料，可以牢牢抓住墙面，并能够快速登崖。

name: Climbing Gear
description: The special no-slip toes of these boots make you a more efficient climber.
obtained: The Climbing Gear can be found as one of Misko's treasures in the North Hyrule Plain Cave. It is hidden behind a Waterfall.
obtained_zh: 攀岩装备位于北赫鲁平原洞穴中的米斯科的宝藏之一。它隐藏在瀑布后面。
description_zh: 使用古代技术制成的登墙用的护手。由于其具有能让指尖防滑，且容易使劲的性能，因此可以变得轻松登崖。

name: Dark Hood
description: Headwear obtained by offering Poes to a strange statue. It resembles the head of a monster born of shadow, and its eyes glow eerie red in the dark.
obtained: The Dark Hood is a piece of Armor that can be purchased from Kilton at his Fang and Bone shop after all Divine Beasts have been freed. It cannot be enhanced by a Great Fairy, nor can it be Dyed at the Kochi Dye Shop. The Dark Hood, alongside the Dark Tunic and Dark Trousers, compose the Dark Series. When the full set is worn, it provides a Night Speed Up bonus. Also, characters get scared when they see Link wearing it.
obtained_zh: 黑暗斗篷是 Kilton 在“Fang and Bone”商店出售的防具，但前提是在解放所有神兽后。它不能被伟大的仙女强化，也不能在 Kochi 的染色店染色。与黑暗长袍、黑暗裤子一起，构成“黑暗系列”。穿完整套时，会获得夜间行动加成。同时，当他们看到林克穿着这件斗篷时，角色会感到害怕。
description_zh: 向一尊奇妙的雕像供奉魄后得到的防具。好像是以影子里诞生的怪物为原型的。红色眼睛还会在黑暗中发出诡异的光。

name: Dark Trousers
description: A tunic obtained by offering Poes to a strange statue. It's a spurious replica of the green outfit once worn by a legendary hero.
obtained: The Dark Trousers are a piece of Armor that can be purchased from Kilton at his Fang and Bone shop after all Divine Beasts have been freed. They cannot be enhanced by a Great Fairy, nor can they be Dyed at the Kochi Dye Shop. The Dark Trousers, alongside the Dark Hood and Dark Tunic, compose the Dark Series. When the full set is worn, it provides a Night Speed Up bonus. Also, characters get scared when they see Link wearing it.
obtained_zh: 暗色裤子是一种装备，可在凯尔顿的“Fang and Bone”商店购买（在所有神兽被解放后）。不能由大妖精强化，也不能在科奇染色店染色。暗色裤子、暗色斗篷和暗色长袍属于“Dark Series”。穿完整套时会获得夜间速度提升效果。同时，看到林克穿着时，其他角色会感到害怕。
description_zh: 向一尊奇妙的雕像供奉魄后得到的防具。乍一看只是一条普通的黑色裤子，但好像是以影子里诞生的怪物为原型的。

name: Dark Tunic
description: Trousers obtained by offering Poes to a strange statue. They look ordinary at first, but on closer inspection, they resemble the legs of a monster born of shadow.
obtained: The Dark Tunic can be bought from any Bargainer Statue for 150 Poes.
obtained_zh: 暗色长袍可以在任何商店摊位处购买，价格为 150 个 Poe。
description_zh: 向一尊奇妙的雕像供奉魄后得到的衣服。和所谓的勇者身上穿的绿色衣服似是而非。

name: Desert Voe Headband
description: Gerudo armor for males. Contains sapphire, which harnesses the power of ice to make the heat more bearable.
obtained_zh: 沙漠 Voe 头巾是可在格鲁多秘密俱乐部（完成“格鲁多的秘密”支线任务后）和塔雷镇的罗恩松盔甲精品店（完成“从地心挖起”支线任务后）购买的防具。 佩戴时提供一个热抗等级。 沙漠 Voe 头巾可以被大精灵强化，并在高池染料店染色。 与沙漠 Voe 背心和沙漠 Voe 长裤一起，构成“沙漠 Voe 套装”。 当每个套装部件都被大精灵强化至少两遍，并完整佩戴时，提供“电抗防御套衫”效果。
description_zh: 在格鲁德地区罕见的男性用防具。额头上镶嵌的蓝宝石蕴含着冰之力量，因其加护，会发挥耐热效果。

name: Desert Voe Spaulder
description: Gerudo armor for males. Contains sapphire, which harnesses the power of ice to make the heat more bearable.
obtained_zh: “沙漠围巾”是一件可以在杰鲁多秘密俱乐部（位于杰鲁多镇）购买的盔甲，需要先完成“杰鲁多秘密”支线任务。也可以在塔雷镇的“红森盔甲坊”购买，需先完成“从零开始”支线任务。佩戴时提供一级热量抗性。 “沙漠围巾”可以通过大精灵强化，并在科奇染料店染色。 “沙漠围巾”（以及“沙漠围巾头带”、“沙漠围巾裤”）是“沙漠围巾套装”。当这三件装备都经过大精灵强化至少两次，且全部穿戴时，会获得“冲击伤害抗性”的套装加成。
description_zh: 在格鲁德秘密俱乐部里秘密售卖的男性用防具。因蕴含冰之力量的蓝宝石加护，装备后，会发挥耐热效果。

name: Desert Voe Trousers
description: Gerudo trousers for males sold in the Gerudo Secret Club. Sapphire used in their creation offers protection from the heat.
obtained_zh: “沙漠之码”是可在格鲁多秘密俱乐部（完成“秘密俱乐部的秘密”任务后）购买，也可在塔雷镇的「龙门盔甲精品店」（完成“从头开始”任务后）购买。穿戴时提供 1 个热量抗性等级。 “沙漠之码”可由大仙强化，并在古驰染料店染色。 与 “沙漠之码帽子”和 “沙漠之码手套”，构成 “沙漠之码套装”。 每个部件至少通过大仙强化两次并完整穿着，则获得“电击伤害抗性套装加成”。
description_zh: 在格鲁德秘密俱乐部里偷偷售卖的男性用裤子。使用的是蕴含冰之力量的蓝宝石，因其加护，会发挥耐热效果。

name: Diamond Circlet
description: A Gerudo headpiece set with a diamond, which increases attack power.
obtained_zh:
钻石项圈是一种护甲配件，可用于头部防护。可在洛梅迷宫岛的一个地下房间内的宝箱中找到。获得后，该房间内的所有腐朽守卫都会激活。林克也可以在格鲁多镇的星光回忆珠宝店购买，价格为 1500 卢比和三个钻石。戴上钻石项圈可以提升一次守护者抗性。同时也提供隐藏效果：增加古代士兵装备和守护者装备的伤害 20%。
可以在大仙女泉对钻石项圈进行强化。但无法在科奇染色店染色。
description_zh: 在格鲁德珠宝店里出售的豪华头饰。因蕴含光之力量的钻石加护，还能增加攻击力。

name: Ember Headdress
description: Used in ancient rituals, this item is made of heat-absorbing cloth that produces flame in high-temperature environments.
obtained: The Ember Headdress can be found within the YunoboCo HQ South Cave in Eldin Canyon. Alongside the Ember Shirt and the Ember Trousers, they are part of the Ember Set.
obtained_zh: “火焰头饰”可在埃尔宾峡谷内的尤诺宝公司总部南洞中找到。它与“火焰衬衫”和“火焰长裤”一起，构成“火焰套装”。
description_zh: 据推测是古代祭祀活动时使用的头饰。由具备蓄热性的材料制成，在高温环境下可以利用四周的热量释放火焰攻击。

name: Ember Shirt
description: Used in ancient rituals, this item is made of heat-absorbing cloth that produces flame in high-temperature environments.
obtained: The Ember Shirt can be found inside a Treasure Chest in the Goronbi River Cave. It is part of the Ember Set, with the other pieces being the Ember Headdress and the Ember Trousers.
obtained_zh: 炽焰战袍可在 Goronbi 河洞穴中的宝箱中找到。它是炽焰套装的一部分，其他部件包括炽焰头饰和炽焰裤子。
description_zh: 据推测是很久以前用于祭祀活动的衣服。由蓄热性很强的布料缝制而成，在高温环境下可以利用四周的热量释放火焰攻击。

name: Ember Trousers
description: Used in ancient rituals, this item is made of heat-absorbing cloth that produces flame in high-temperature environments.
obtained: The Ember Trousers are a piece of Armor that can be found in the Cephla Lake Cave in Eldin Canyon. They are part of the Ember Set, alongside the Ember Headdress and the Ember Shirt.
obtained_zh: “火焰裤”是一件护甲，可在埃尔丁峡谷中的塞普拉湖洞穴中找到。它是“火焰套装”的一部分，包括“火焰头饰”和“火焰上衣”。
description_zh: 据推测是古时候为祭祀活动缝制的裤子。由于所用的布料具有蓄热性，在高温环境下可以利用四周的热量释放火焰攻击。

name: Evil Spirit Armor
description: Some believe this armor is inspirited by a malevolent entity. It's a rather rare find.
obtained:
The Phantom Ganon Armor is a piece of Armor exclusive to The Champions' Ballad Downloadable Content pack. Obtaining the Phantom Ganon Armor is one part of the objective of the "EX Treasure: Dark Armor" Side Quest. The Armor was stolen from Hyrule Castle by Misko and a clue to its location can be found in Misko's EX Journal 2 at the Deya Village Ruins. The metallic Treasure Chest that hides the Phantom Ganon Armor can be found submerged in Floria River underneath Sarjon Bridge. Link must use the Magnesis Rune to pull the Chest from the River to retrieve it.
When worn, the Armor provides one level of Stealth Up. The Phantom Ganon Armor cannot be enhanced by a Great Fairy nor can it be Dyed at the Kochi Dye Shop. The Phantom Ganon Armor, alongside the Phantom Ganon Skull and Phantom Ganon Greaves, compose the Phantom Ganon Set. When the Phantom Ganon Armor is worn with the Bokoblin Mask, Flamebreaker Helm, Salvager Headwear, Zant's Helmet, Hylian Hood, or Ravio's Hood, its cape will be removed. 
According to its description, it is believed that the Phantom Ganon Armor is infused with a dark entity that resembles the Great King of Evil. After obtaining the Phantom Ganon Armor, Granté in Tarrey Town will begin selling it for 50 Rupees.
obtained_zh:
幽灵加农盔是《勇者之歌》下载内容包独有的装备。获得幽灵加农盔是“EX宝藏：黑暗盔甲”支线任务的一部分。这套盔由米斯柯从海拉鲁城堡偷走，在德亚村遗迹的米斯柯 EX 记录 2 中可以找到线索。隐藏着幽灵加农盔的金光宝箱位于萨琼桥下的弗洛利亚河中。林克需要使用磁力符文将宝箱从河里拉出以取回。
穿戴后，这套盔提供 1 点隐身效果。幽灵加农盔不能通过伟大精灵强化，也不能在科奇染色店染色。幽灵加农盔（包括幽灵加农头盔和幽灵加农长靴）构成幽灵加农套装。当与博科林面具、火焰破斧帽、搜寻者头饰、赞特的头盔、海拉鲁斗篷或拉维欧斗篷搭配时，这套盔的斗篷会被移除。
根据描述，人们认为幽灵加农盔被黑暗实体附身，该实体与邪恶之王相似。获得幽灵加农盔后，塔雷镇的格兰特将开始以 50 鲁币出售它。
description_zh: 据说是从异次元而来的恶灵所穿的铠甲装束。这样的珍贵物品并非轻易就能得到。

name: Evil Spirit Greaves
description: Some believe these greaves are inspired by a malevolent entity. They're a rather rare find.
obtained:
The Phantom Ganon Greaves are a piece of Armor exclusive to The Champions' Ballad Downloadable Content pack. Obtaining the Phantom Ganon Greaves is one part of the objective of the "EX Treasure: Dark Armor" Side Quest. The Greaves were stolen from Hyrule Castle by Misko and a clue to their location can be found in Misko's EX Journal 2 at the Deya Village Ruins. The metallic Treasure Chest that hides the Phantom Ganon Greaves can be found buried in the ground near a bird statue in Ebara Forest. Link must use the Magnesis Rune to dislodge the Chest from the ground to retrieve the Greaves.
When worn, the Greaves provide one level of Stealth Up. The Phantom Ganon Greaves cannot be enhanced by a Great Fairy nor can they be Dyed at the Kochi Dye Shop. The Phantom Ganon Greaves, alongside the Phantom Ganon Skull and Phantom Ganon Armor, compose the Phantom Ganon Set.
According to their description, it is believed that the Phantom Ganon Greaves are infused with a dark entity that resembles the Great King of Evil. After obtaining the Phantom Ganon Greaves, Granté in Tarrey Town will begin selling them for 50 Rupees.
obtained_zh:
“幽灵加农靴”是《勇者之歌》下载内容独有的装备。获得“幽灵加农靴”是完成“EX宝藏：黑暗盔甲”支线的任务之一。这些靴子被米斯科从海拉鲁城堡偷走，可以在德雅村遗迹中的米斯科的“EX日志 2”中找到线索。隐藏“幽灵加农靴”的金属宝箱位于伊巴拉森林的一座雕像附近的地底下。林克需要使用磁力符文将宝箱从地上挖出来，从而获得这些靴子。

佩戴后，“幽灵加农靴”可以提升隐身能力一级。 “幽灵加农靴”不能通过大精灵进行强化，也不能在科奇染色店进行染色。“幽灵加农靴”、“幽灵加农头盔”和“幽灵加农铠甲”共同组成“幽灵加农套装”。

根据描述，“幽灵加农靴”被赋予了一种黑暗实体，类似于邪恶之王。获得后，塔雷城中的格兰特将开始以50鲁比的价格出售这些靴子。
description_zh: 据说是从异次元而来的恶灵所穿的护胫。这样的珍贵物品并非轻易就能得到。

name: Evil Spirit Mask
description: Some believe this eerie mask is inspired by a malevolent entity. It's a rather rare find.
obtained:
The Phantom Ganon Skull is a piece of Armor exclusive to The Champions' Ballad Downloadable Content pack. Obtaining the Phantom Ganon Skull is one part of the objective of the "EX Treasure: Dark Armor" Side Quest. The Skull was stolen from Hyrule Castle by Misko and a clue to its location can be found in Misko's EX Journal 2 at the Deya Village Ruins. The Hidden Chest that contains the Phantom Ganon Skull can be found submerged under the highest of the three Floria Falls flowing south from Corta Lake to Lake Floria. Link must use the Magnesis Rune to pull the Chest from the Waterfall to retrieve it.
When worn, the Skull provides one level of Stealth Up. The Phantom Ganon Skull cannot be enhanced by a Great Fairy nor can it be Dyed at the Kochi Dye Shop. The Phantom Ganon Skull, alongside the Phantom Ganon Armor and Phantom Ganon Greaves, compose the Phantom Ganon Set.
According to its description, it is believed that the Phantom Ganon Skull is infused with a dark entity that resembles the Great King of Evil. After obtaining the Phantom Ganon Skull, Granté in Tarrey Town will begin selling it for 50 Rupees.
obtained_zh:
“幽灵加农头盔”是《勇者之歌》下载内容独有的装备。获得“EX宝藏：黑暗盔甲”支线任务的一部分，需要获取幽灵加农头盔。该头盔被弥斯科从海拉鲁城堡偷走，可在德亚村遗迹的弥斯科 EX 日记 2 中找到线索。

包含幽灵加农头盔的隐藏箱位于三个从 Corta Lake 流向 Lake Floria 的瀑布中最上面的位置。林克需要使用“磁力”符文将箱子从瀑布中拉出，以获取该头盔。
佩戴后，头盔提供 1 点隐身效果。幽灵加农头盔不能通过大妖精强化，也不能在科奇染料店染色。幽灵加农头盔、幽灵加农套装和幽灵加农护腿共同组成幽灵加农套装。

根据描述，认为幽灵加农头盔融合了黑暗实体，与“邪恶之王”相似。获得幽灵加农头盔后，塔雷镇的格兰特将开始以 50 卢比的价格出售该头盔。
description_zh: 据说是从异次元而来的恶灵所戴的令人害怕的头盔。这样的珍贵物品并非轻易就能得到。

name: Fierce Deity Armor
description: Armor worn by the hero from a world in which the moon threatened to fall. Wearing it provides godlike power.
obtained_zh:
“狂暴之神”套装是《三人合战英雄》2.0.0版本中新增的。通过首次完成“试炼之厅”即可获得。佩戴后，“狂暴之神”套装会使林克的剑威力翻倍，并且当林克挥剑时，还可以发射四个剑光，形成十字形状（前提是林克的生命值已满）。即使生命值未满，在进行旋风攻击时也可以发射剑光。此外，佩戴“狂暴之神”套装后，林克将始终保持稳定，不会被敌人击退。
通过下载游玩获得的任何林克都无法获得“狂暴之神”套装。
description_zh: 落月世界的勇者所拥有的服装。穿上后，身体里会涌出鬼神般的力量。

name: Fierce Deity Boots
description: Boots worn by a hero from a world in which the moon threatened to fall. Wearing them provides godlike power.
obtained_zh:
《旷野：神秘之息》

狂战士神装靴是《旷野：神秘之息》中的一件盔甲。通过使用 amiibo 功能扫描《塞尔达传说》系列中的 Majora's Mask 主题 Link amiibo，可获得。据描述，狂战士神装靴与英雄时代狂战士所穿的靴子相同。

穿着狂战士神装靴可以提升 1 点攻击力。可以通过大仙进行强化，但无法在 Kochi 染料店染色。狂战士神装靴、狂战士盔甲和狂战士面具组成“狂战士套装”。

《王国：泪滴之心》
description_zh: 落月世界的勇者所携带的靴子。穿上后，身体里会涌出鬼神般的力量。

name: Fierce Deity Mask
description: A mask worn by a hero from a world in which the moon was falling, granting godlike power.
obtained_zh:
"狂战士之面具"是五种可以改变Link形态的面具之一。穿戴后，Link会变成“狂战士形态”，拥有独特的高大成年形态和声音，并可使用“狂战士之剑”。攻击力和范围大幅提升（与“伟大小仙之剑”相似），且使用剑能释放光束消耗魔力。获得后，建议谨慎使用，因为它可能具有类似"Majora's Mask"的危险性。
Link可以通过向四个“月之儿童”兑换二十种非转化面具来获得"狂战士之面具"。由于"德库面具"、"哥龙面具"和"水之面具"无法兑换，Link必须先拥有所有其他面具后才能获得"狂战士之面具"。随后，英雄从戴着"Majora's Mask"的孩子那里得到面具。他们一起“玩耍”。据说它拥有所有面具的优点。
"狂战士之面具"只能在Boss战和《Majora's Mask 3D》中的钓场中使用。但在钓场中，它的战斗能力失效，且钓场的人会阻止Link离开。

"狂战士之面具"是《Breath of the Wild》中的一件护甲。通过使用带有"Majora's Mask Link" amiibo 的amiibo Rune来获得。根据描述，这件护甲与在英雄时代Link佩戴的面具相同，但已经失去了原有的能力。穿戴后，提供一个攻击加成等级。 类似于《Majora's Mask》，“狂战士之面具”的眼睛会发光，可以在黑暗区域（如"Thyphlo Ruins"）中被看到。"狂战士之面具"可以由伟大小仙增强，但不能在"Kochi Dye Shop"进行染色。 "狂战士之面具"、以及与之配套的"狂战士之护甲"和"狂战士之靴"，构成"狂战士套装"。
description_zh: 落月世界的勇者所携带的防具。看上去有些恐怖，但戴上之后，身体里会涌出鬼神般的力量。

name: Flamebreaker Armor
description: Fire-resistant armor crafted by Gorons for Hylians curious enough to visit Goron City.
obtained: Flamebreaker Armors appear as pieces of Armor in Tears of the Kingdom that can be purchased at the Ripped and Shredded Shop in Goron City, like their Breath of the Wild incarnation.
obtained_zh: 火焰之盾盔出现在《塞尔达传说：王国之泪》中，可在格隆城的“Ripped and Shredded”商店购买，与前作类似。
description_zh: 鼓隆族为来到鼓隆城旅行的好奇人类所打造的铠甲。它由石头加工而成，具有耐火性能。

name: Flamebreaker Boots
description: Goron artisans used flame-resistant rocks to craft these fireproof boots for Hylians visiting Goron City.
obtained: The Flamebreaker Boots reappear as Armor in Tears of the Kingdom, providing one level of Flame Guard once again.
obtained_zh: 火焰破甲靴在《塞尔达传说：王国之泪》中再次以防具形式出现，提供一层火焰防御。
description_zh: 鼓隆族的工匠专为拜访鼓隆城的海利亚人所打造的鞋。使用以石头为主的不可燃材料制作而成，具有耐火性能。

name: Flamebreaker Helm
description: Stone headgear made for tourists by Goron crafters. Not only is it flame-resistant, but it also covers your entire head.
obtained: Flamebreaker Helms are Armor pieces that provide Flame Guard.
obtained_zh: 火焰防御护甲：提供火焰防护效果。
description_zh: 鼓隆族的工匠面向拜访鼓隆城的观光客而打造的石制头盔。可以整个套在头上，具有耐火性能。

name: Froggy Hood
description: A good hood for a rainy day. The perfectly weighted headband keeps the Wearer focus and stabilized, making it easier to climb wet, slippery surfaces.
obtained: The Froggy Hood is part of the Froggy Armor Set. Penn will give it to Link on Traysi's behalf as part of the "Potential Princess Sightings!" Side Adventure.
obtained_zh: Froggy Hood是Froggy Armor套装的一部分。Penn会代表Traysi将它交给Link，作为“潜在公主 sighting!”支线任务的一部分。
description_zh: 适合在多雨地区活动时穿戴的头巾。护额能抑制头部的晃动，并稳定重心，因此能更容易攀登潮湿打滑的表面。

name: Froggy Leggings
description: Good leggings for a rainy day. The feet are covered in small dimples and fed with an anti-slip substance, giving them great traction on wet, slippery surfaces.
obtained: The Froggy Leggings are a part of the Froggy Armor Set. Penn gives them to Link on Traysi's behalf as part of the "Potential Princess Sightings!" Side Adventure.
obtained_zh: “Froggy Leggings”是“Froggy Armor Set”的一部分。佩恩代替Traysi将它们送给林克，作为“Potential Princess Sightings!”支线任务的一部分。
description_zh: 适合在多雨地区活动时穿戴的足袋。脚底面有细小紧密的纹路，且涂有防滑的药剂，所以即使是潮湿的表面也不容易打滑。

name: Froggy Sleeve
description: A good sleeve for a rainy day. Small dimples on the fingers act as suction cups, giving good grip on wet, slippery surfaces.
obtained: The Froggy Sleeve is part of the Froggy Armor Set. Link will receive it from Penn as part of the "Potential Princess Sightings!" Side Adventure.
obtained_zh: Froggy Sleeve是Froggy Armor套装的一部分。链接将在“潜在公主 sighting!”支线任务中，从Penn那里获得它。
description_zh: 适合在多雨地区活动时穿戴的手甲。刻在指腹部位的细纹能起到吸盘的作用，即使攀登潮湿的表面也不容易滑落。

name: Frostbite Headdress
description: Used in ancient rituals, this item's cold-absorbing cloth produces frost in low-temperature environments.
obtained: The Frostbite Headdress is a piece of Armor head gear. It can be found in the Lake Kilsie Cave. When worn, it imbues the Cold Weather Attack effect, which increases Link's attack power and allows him to generate a ring of ice when using a Charged Attack in Freezing Climates. Additionally, the horns on the Headdress will glow blue when worn in a Freezing Climate.
obtained_zh: 寒冰头盔是防具的一种头部装备。可在基尔西湖洞穴中找到。佩戴后，会获得“寒冷天气攻击”效果，增加林克的攻击力并允许他在冰冻环境中使用蓄力攻击时生成一个冰环。此外，头盔上的角在冰冻环境中会发出蓝色光芒。
description_zh: 据推测是古时候为祭祀活动制作的头饰。由具备冷媒性质的材料制成，低温环境下可以释放冷气攻击。

name: Frostbite Shirt
description: Used in ancient rituals, this item's cold-absorbing cloth produces frost in low-temperature environments.
obtained: The Frostbite Shirt is a piece of Armor torso gear. It can be found in the Brightcap Cave. When worn, it imbues the Cold Weather Attack effect, which increases Link's attack power and allows him to generate a ring of ice when using a Charged Attack in Freezing Climates. Additionally, it will glow with a snowflake pattern when worn in a Freezing Climate.
obtained_zh: “冰冻衬衫”是一种盔甲，位于Brightcap洞穴。穿着后，会赋予Link“寒冷天气攻击”效果，提高他的攻击力，并在寒冷气候下使用Charged Attack时，能生成一个冰环。同时，在寒冷气候下穿着时，会发出雪花图案。
description_zh: 据推测是古代祭祀活动时使用的衣服。由于布料用到了冷媒材料，低温环境下可以释放冷气攻击。

name: Frostbite Trousers
description: Used in ancient rituals, this item's cold-absorbing cloth produces frost in low-temperature environments.
obtained: The Frostbite Trousers are a piece of Armor legwear. They can be found in the Hebra Headspring Cave. When worn, they imbue the Cold Weather Attack effect, which increases Link's attack power and allows him to generate a ring of ice when using a Charged Attack in Freezing Climates. Additionally, they will glow with a snowflake pattern when worn in a Freezing Climate.
obtained_zh: 冰霜战裤是盔甲类型的护腿。可在赫布拉泉洞中找到。穿上后，会赋予“寒冷天气攻击”效果，增加林克的攻击力，并使其在寒冷气候下使用蓄能攻击时产生冰环。此外，在寒冷气候下穿着时，还会呈现出雪花图案。
description_zh: 据推测是很久以前用于祭祀活动的裤子。由于使用的布料具有冷媒的性质，低温环境下可以释放冷气攻击。

name: Gaiters of the Depths
description: Gaiters acquired by offering Poes to a strange statue found in the Depths. They offer some resistance to gloom.
obtained_zh: 地底：向物欲魔像（Bargainer Statue）用"魄"购买（150 个）。需先在地底找到足够数量的物欲魔像后解锁出售。
description_zh: 通过向奇异雕像奉献魄而获得的绑腿。使用的材料似乎取自怪物，因此可以略微阻挡瘴气的影响。

name: Glide Mask
description: A mask with a wind-resistant design that allows for steadier gliding while the wearer plummets from the sky.
obtained: The Glide Mask can be obtained from a Steward Construct after completing the dive ceremony on Valor Island.
obtained_zh: 在瓦勒岛完成潜水仪式后，可以从管家建造处获得Glide Mask。
description_zh: 设计成能够降低来自前方的空气阻力的面罩。在依靠整流气体的俯冲过程中，能够实现稳定的滑翔。

name: Glide Shirt
description: The cloth sewn to this shirt helps it "catch" air, increasing the wearer's ability to glide while they plummet from the sky.
obtained: The Glide Shirt is a piece of Armor that grants Link Skydive Mobility Up, increasing his movement speed while Skydiving. It is given out as a reward for completing the ancient Zonai Dive Ceremony on Courage Island. Link can obtain the Glide Shirt by completing the Dive Ceremony in 35 seconds or less.
obtained_zh: “滑翔服”是一种护甲，可以给林克提供“自由落体”移动能力加成，从而提高他在自由落体的移动速度。它是通过在勇气岛上完成古老的泽诺亚自由落体仪式来获得的奖励。林克可以通过在35秒或更短的时间内完成此项仪式来获得“滑翔服”。
description_zh: 布料紧贴上半身各处，以捕捉空气产生升力的紧身服。提升俯冲时的滑翔性能。

name: Glide Tights
description: The cloth sewn to these tights allows their wearer to glide more easily as they plummet from the sky.
obtained: The Glide Tights can be obtained from a Steward Construct after completing the Dive Ceremony on Bravery Island.
obtained_zh: 在完成“勇敢岛”上的潜水仪式后，可以从管家生物处获得Glide Tights。
description_zh: 布料紧贴下半身各处的紧身裤。通过提高空气阻力，使得俯冲时更容易滑翔。

name: Hood of the Depths
description: A hood acquired by offering Poes to a strange statue found in the Depths. It offers some resistance to gloom.
obtained_zh: 地底：向物欲魔像（Bargainer Statue）用"魄"购买（150 个）。需先在地底找到足够数量的物欲魔像后解锁出售。
description_zh: 通过向奇异雕像奉献魄而获得的头巾。使用的材料似乎来源于怪物，因此具有使佩戴者不易受到瘴气影响的特性。

name: Horriblin Mask
description: Kilton's handmade Horriblin headgear. The big nose and smiley mouth look just like those of the real monster...
obtained: The Horriblin Mask is a piece of Armor that can be obtained from Koltin's Stall for four Bubbul Gems after trading a total of 25 Bubbul Gems for the prior rewards. Subsequent Horriblin Masks can be purchased from Cece for 4,000 Rupees. When worn, the Horriblin Mask grants Link the Disguise Added Effect, allowing him to blend in with Horriblins. However, the Horriblin Mask does not prevent other Enemies in the same area from attacking Link. It also makes quiet Horriblin sounds as Link moves around. While wearing the Horriblin Mask, Link adopts a new idle pose to match that of a Horriblin.
obtained_zh: “恐怖面具”是一件可以通过科林斯的摊位获得，需要先用25颗“泡泡宝石”换取其他奖励后，再花费4颗“泡泡宝石”，最终获得。后续的“恐怖面具”可以从赛赛处购买，价格为4000卢比。佩戴后，“恐怖面具”会赋予链接“伪装”效果，使其能够融入“恐怖兽”。但“恐怖面具”并不能阻止其他敌人攻击链接，同时在链接移动时还会发出“恐怖兽”的声音。“恐怖面具”佩戴后，链接会采用与“恐怖兽”相似的站立姿势。
description_zh: 吉尔顿亲手制作的霍拉布林面罩。大大的鼻子和微笑的嘴角都做得很像。戴上之后，很难被霍拉布林发现。

name: Hylian Hood
description: A hood woven using traditional Hyrulean methods, made from sturdy material.
obtained: The Hylian Hood can be purchased from Mubs's Armor Shop at Lookout Landing. After the mayoral election in Hateno Village, Link can speak to Cece to customize the Hylian Hood by wearing it down.
obtained_zh: 在哈特诺村的 Lookout Landing，你可以从 Mubs 的盔甲店购买 "贤者斗篷"。 在哈特诺村选举后，林克可以与 Cecie 交流，通过穿着该斗篷来定制它。
description_zh: 选取海拉鲁传统工艺织出的结实布料，并以此制成的兜帽。由于可以保护头部免受风雨和强烈日晒，因此深受旅行者欢迎。

name: Hylian Trousers
description: These trousers are common throughout the Hyrule region. The soft fabric makes them quite comfortable.
obtained: Hylian Trousers appear in Tears of the Kingdom.
obtained_zh: 在《塞尔达传说：王国之泪》中出现。
description_zh: 在海拉鲁深受人们喜爱的普通裤子。用柔软的布料制成，非常舒服。而且做工结实，作为旅行装束也很受欢迎。

name: Hylian Tunic
description: A common garb popular in Hyrule, especially among travelers. Its light-yet-sturdy fabric doesn't limit movement.
obtained: Hylian Tunics appear in Tears of the Kingdom.
obtained_zh: 《塞尔达传说：王国之泪》中出现希利亚制服。
description_zh: 在海拉鲁深受人们喜爱的普通装束。用既轻薄又结实的布料制成，方便活动。在旅行者中穿的人也很多。

name: Korok Mask
description: A mask inspired by those fun-loving Koroks. It shakes when one is nearby. It's a rather rare find.
obtained: The Korok Mask can be found in the Forest Coliseum in the Great Hyrule Forest Depths. When Link enters the Coliseum, he will be greeted by two Yiga Footsoldiers, who release a Black Hinox to attack him. Once Link defeats the Black Hinox, a shroud of Gloom over a Treasure Chest clears, allowing him to collect the Korok Mask.
obtained_zh: 在伟大彼尤尔森林深处的森林竞技场，可以找到“科罗克面具”。当林克进入竞技场时，会遇到两名义加士兵，他们会释放一只黑色的希诺克斯进行攻击。林克击败黑色的希诺克斯后，一个藏宝箱周围的黑暗笼罩消失，允许林克拾取“科罗克面具”。
description_zh: 仿照克洛格们戴着的面具制作而成。如果附近有克洛格，就会咯噔咯噔地摇晃。这样的珍品并非轻易就能得到。

name: Lightning Helm
description: The Yiga copied a precious heirloom passed down among the Gerudo for this helm. Adorned with topaz, it deflects lightning.
obtained: The Lightning Helm is a piece of Armor head gear. It is a copy of the Thunder Helm made by the Yiga Clan, and is adorned with Topaz that grants it the ability to deflect Lightning via the Lightning Proof Added Effect. It can be obtained from the Yiga Clan Training Mini-Game in the Yiga Clan Hideout.
obtained_zh: 闪电头盔是一件护甲类型，是由伊加部落制作的雷神头盔的复制品。头顶镶嵌着方型石，赋予其通过“防闪电”效果来抵挡闪电的能力。可以通过伊加部落训练小游戏在伊加部落据点获得。
description_zh: 作为格鲁德族的神器而代代相传的头盔的仿制品。由依盖队制作而成。内部填入了无数黄玉，能够弹开雷击。

name: Lizalfos Mask
description: Kilton's handmade Lizalfos headgear. It's designed to replicate even the goggling eyeballs of the Lizalfos.
obtained: The Lizalfos Mask returns in Tears of the Kingdom, functioning the same as it did in Breath of the Wild. It can be obtained from Koltin's Stall for three Bubbul Gems after trading a total of 11 Bubbul Gems for the prior rewards. Subsequent Lizalfos Masks can be purchased from Cece for 4000 Rupees.
obtained_zh: 在《旷野之泪》中，《蜥蜴人面具》功能相同，如同《荒野之息》。可以从科尔汀的摊位获得，需要用11个"泡泡宝石"换取。后续的《蜥蜴人面具》(4个)可从塞丝处购买4000卢比。
description_zh: 吉尔顿亲手制作的蜥蜴战士面罩。灵活转动瞪出的眼球也被制作得栩栩如生。戴上之后，很难被蜥蜴战士发现。

name: Lobster Shirt
description: A soft, comfortable shirt traditional to a southern island. It's made of breathable fabric, so it's well-suited to warm regions.
obtained: {{Infobox Game Blocks
description_zh: 一件柔软舒适、传统的南方岛屿款衬衫。采用透气面料，适合温暖地区。
obtained_zh: 游戏信息框

name: Lynel Mask
description: Kilton's handmade Lynel headgear. It's so well-crafted that it can deceive a real Lynel.
obtained: The Lynel Mask returns in Tears of the Kingdom, functioning the same as it did in Breath of the Wild with the exception of the Lynels in the Floating Coliseum, as they are scripted to attack Link without provocation. It can be obtained from Koltin's Stall for four Bubbul Gems after trading a total of 33 Bubbul Gems for the prior rewards. Subsequent Lynel Masks can be purchased from Cece for 4000 Rupees.
obtained_zh: 在《塞尔达传说：王国之泪》中，林埃尔面具功能与《旷野之息》相同，但位于漂浮竞技场的林埃尔会主动攻击林克。可以通过向科尔廷的摊位换取4颗泡泡宝石（此前累计33颗泡泡宝石）获得。后续的林埃尔面具可以从塞塞处购买，价格为4000鲁比。
description_zh: 吉尔顿亲手制作的莱尼尔面罩。惟妙惟肖，甚至能骗过莱尼尔的眼睛。戴上之后，很难被发现。

name: Majora's Mask
description: An eerie mask passed down from ancient times. Wearing it makes it harder for certain enemies to spot you. It's a rather rare find.
description_zh: 从太古时期留传下来的面具。戴上它的话，有些怪物就不容易发现自己。这样的珍品并非轻易就能得到。
obtained_zh: 地底·浮游斗技场（海拉鲁平原鸟望台南侧深穴下方）：连续战胜 5 场斗技场战斗后从宝箱获得。

name: Mask of Awakening
description: Legend says this mask resembles a hero who explored a mysterious place that one could visit but not leave.
obtained_zh: 提升，增强
description_zh: 据说某位勇者曾前往一座进入后就无法再离开的神奇岛屿冒险，这是以他为原型设计的面具。让人又想一直戴着，又想快点摘下来。

name: Midna's Helmet
description: A helmet much like the one Midna wore when she fought alongside the Hero of Twilight. It's a rather rare find.
obtained:
Midna's Helmet is a piece of Armor that Link can wear on his head. It is exclusive to The Master Trials Downloadable Content pack. The bandit Misko stole it from Hyrule Castle, along with several other treasures. During the "EX Treasure: Twilight Relic" Side Quest, Link is tasked with reading Misko's EX Journal 2 in order to learn the location of Midna's Helmet. In reading it, he discovers that the Helmet can be found at the ruins of a temple flooded by the Regencia River. At the Sage Temple Ruins, Link will find a Hidden Chest embedded in the ground, which contains Midna's Helmet. Midna's Helmet grants both Guardian Resist Up and Ancient Pow Up.
Once acquired, Granté will begin selling Midna's Helmet for 50 Rupees. Furthermore it cannot be Dyed at the Kochi Dye Shop or enhanced by a Great Fairy.
obtained_zh:
宁娜之盔是一件链接可以佩戴在头上的防具，只存在于《主试下载内容》中。强盗米斯科从海拉鲁城堡偷走了它，以及其他一些宝物。在“EX宝藏：暮色遗迹”支线任务中，链接的任务是阅读米科的EX日志2，以了解宁娜之盔的位置。通过阅读，他发现盔可以在被莱戈尼亚河淹没的寺庙废墟上找到。在圣驾寺废墟，链接会找到一个埋在地下的隐藏箱子，其中包含宁娜之盔。宁娜之盔可以提升防御力和古代力量。
获得后，格兰特将以50卢比的价格出售它。 此外，它不能在库奇染料店染色，也不能由大仙增强。
description_zh: 据说是和黄昏勇者一起为海拉鲁而战的影子女王所佩戴的王冠。这样的珍贵物品并非轻易就能得到。

name: Miner's Mask
description: A mask used for working in darkness. The attached lamps are filled with bioluminescent material to light one's surroundings.
obtained: The Miner's Mask is a piece of Armor. It generates a small Glow when worn. It can be found in a Treasure Chest in the Abandoned Kara Kara Mine in the Depths. It is part of the Miner Set, alongside the Miner's Top and the Miner's Trousers.
obtained_zh: 矿工面具是盔甲，佩戴时会发出微弱的光芒。可在废弃卡拉卡矿（Depths）的卡拉卡矿中找到，属于“矿工套装”，包括矿工头盔和矿工裤。
description_zh: 据说是在黑暗中作业时使用的面罩。悬挂其上的灯中装填了发光物质，能微微照亮周围。

name: Miner's Top
description: A shirt featuring lamps of various sizes filled with bioluminescent material. Made to help with excavating dark environments.
obtained: The Miner's Top is found in a Treasure Chest on top of a broken structure in Daphnes Canyon Mine. It emits a Glow when worn by Link, which helps to illuminate the surroundings while exploring the Depths or other forms of Darkness. It is part of the Miner Set, which also includes the Miner's Mask and the Miner's Trousers.
obtained_zh: 矿工头盔位于达芬斯峡谷矿坑崩塌结构的顶部，存在于一个宝箱中。佩戴后会发出光芒，帮助链接在探索深渊或黑暗区域时提供照明。它是矿工套装的一部分，包括矿工面具和矿工裤。
description_zh: 装饰着大大小小的灯的衣服，灯里填满了发光物质。据说是专为在黑暗环境中采掘等工作而制作的。

name: Miner's Trousers
description: The bioluminescent lamps on these trousers shed light on where you step. They come in handy when walking in darkness.
obtained: The Miner's Trousers are pieces of Armor that belong to the Miner Set. They can be found in a Treasure Chest in the Hylia Canyon Mine. When worn, they emit a small Glow. The Miner's Trousers are sturdy pants with metal chains along their sides and front connecting to bulb-shaped lights along the calves. They bear metallic boots, which have three pronounced toes each. When Enhanced at least twice, they can contribute toward the Shining Steps Set Bonus in the Miner Set.
obtained_zh: 矿工裤：属于矿工套装的盔甲，可在海利亚峡谷矿脉的箱子中找到。穿戴后会发出微弱的光芒。矿工裤是结实的长裤，两侧和正面有金属链连接到球形灯上。还配有金属靴，每只靴有三个突出的大趾。如果经过至少两次强化，可以为矿工套装中的“闪耀步”套装提供额外奖励。
description_zh: 配备了装有发光物质的灯的裤子，可以照亮脚边。在黑暗中前行时能派上大用场。

name: Moblin Mask
description: Kilton's handmade Moblin headgear. It's designed to replicate the distinct, long, Moblin nose and hanging tongue.
obtained: The Moblin Mask returns in Tears of the Kingdom, functioning the same as it did in Breath of the Wild. It can be obtained from Koltin's Stall for two Bubbul Gems after completing "The Hunt for Bubbul Gems!" and "The Search for Koltin". Subsequent Moblin Masks can be purchased from Cece for 4000 Rupees.
obtained_zh: 在《塞尔达传说：王国之泪》中，Moblin面具功能与《旷野之息》相同。可在Koltin的摊位用两个“Bubbul宝石”购买（需完成“寻找Bubbul宝石！”和“寻找Koltin”任务）。后续的Moblin面具可在Cece处购买4000卢比。
description_zh: 吉尔顿亲手制作的莫力布林面罩。特色的长鼻子和悬垂的舌头都被再现出来。戴上之后，很难被莫力布林发现。

name: Mystic Headpiece
description: Headgear acquired in exchange for Bubbul gems. Made with prayers spirits, it protects the wear allowing them to lose rupees instead of health when hit.
obtained: The Mystic Headpiece is a piece of Armor head gear. It can be obtained by trading a total of 45 Bubbul Gems to Koltin.
obtained_zh: 神秘头盔是护甲类装备，可以通过向科尔坦兑换45个“泡泡宝石”获得。
description_zh: 通过交换魔犹伊的遗失物获得的护额。蕴含着对精灵的祈愿而受其加护，因此受到攻击时卢比会代替体力减少。

name: Mystic Robe
description: A robe acquired in exchange for, Bubbul gems. Woven with prayers to spirits, it protects the wearer, allowing them to lose rupees instead of health when hit.
obtained: The Mystic Robe is a piece of Armor torso gear. It can be obtained by trading a total of seven Bubbul Gems to Koltin. When worn, taking damage will cause Link to lose Rupees instead of Hearts. For every quarter of a Heart that Link would take, he will instead lose 10 Rupees. However, there is a limit to how much damage will be converted into Rupees at once. At one level of Rupee Padding, up to three Hearts-worth of damage will be converted, six Hearts at level two, and nine Hearts at level three. Once this threshold has been passed, Link will take any remaining damage. In addition, the Mystic Robe is unable to mitigate any damage dealt by Gloom.
obtained_zh: 《神秘长袍》是一种防具，可以向孔廷交易七个“泡泡宝石”获得。穿戴后，链接会损失卢比而不是生命值。每失去一小部分生命值（四分之一），链接会损失10卢比。但总损失有上限：第一层可转换三小部分生命值，第二层六小部分，第三层九小部分。超过这个上限后，链接将直接承受剩余伤害。此外，《神秘长袍》无法抵挡《乌托》造成的任何伤害。
description_zh: 通过交换魔犹伊的遗失物获得的装束。蕴含着对精灵的祈愿织成，受其加护，因此受到攻击时卢比会代替体力减少。

name: Mystic Trousers
description: Trousers acquired in exchange for Bubbul gems. Each thread is blessed by spirits, protecting the wearer by allowig them to lose rupees instead of health when hit.
obtained: The Mystic Trousers are a piece of Armor leg gear. They can be obtained by trading a total of 20 Bubbul Gems to Koltin.
obtained_zh: 神秘裤是一种护甲的腿部装备。可以通过向科尔틴交易总共20个“泡泡宝石”来获得。
description_zh: 通过交换魔犹伊的遗失物获得的裤子。一针一线蕴含着对精灵的祈愿而受其加护，因此受到攻击时卢比会代替体力减少。

name: Opal Earrings
description: Earrings containing opal, a gem that harnesses the power of water to increase your swimming speed.
obtained_zh:
宝石耳环是一种配饰，可以佩戴在林克的耳朵上。可在格鲁多镇的“星光回忆珠宝店”购买，价格为200卢比和八颗宝石。佩戴后，会提升游泳速度一级。
宝石耳环可以在巨灵之泉处由巨灵进行升级。但是，无法在巧奇染色店染色。
description_zh: 在格鲁德珠宝店里出售的耳坠。因蕴含水之力量的蛋白石加护，戴上之后，会提升游泳速度。

name: Phantom Armor
description: Myths abound about armored phantoms that terrorized brave heroes. This piece looks just like the armor they allegedly wore. It's a rather rare find.
obtained:
The Phantom Armor is a piece of Armor exclusive to The Master Trials DLC Pack. Obtaining it is one part of the objective of the "EX Treasure: Phantasma" Side Quest. The Armor was stolen from Hyrule Castle by Misko and a clue to its location can be found in Misko's EX Journal at the Outpost Ruins. The Treasure Chest that hides the Phantom Armor can be found buried in the southeast of the Sacred Ground Ruins. After obtaining the Phantom Armor, Granté will begin selling it for 50 Rupees.
When worn, the Armor provides one level of Attack Up. The Phantom Armor cannot be enhanced by a Great Fairy nor can it be Dyed at the Kochi Dye Shop. The Phantom Armor, alongside the Phantom Helmet and Phantom Greaves, compose the Phantom Equipment.
obtained_zh:
“幽灵盔甲”是一种独属于《大师试炼》DLC的装备。获取它，是完成任务“EX宝藏：幻影”支线任务的一部分。 Misko盗取了这件盔甲，并在 Outpost Ruins 的 EX Journal 中可以找到线索，宝箱位于 Sacred Ground Ruins 的东南部，隐藏着幽灵盔甲。获得幽灵盔甲后，Granté 将以 50 卢比的价格出售。
佩戴时，提供一次攻击力提升。 幽灵盔甲不能通过大精灵增强，也不能在 Kochi Dye Shop 进行染色。 “幽灵盔甲”与“幽灵头盔”和“幽灵胫甲”共同构成了“幽灵装备”。
description_zh: 据说是以前甲胄怪物所戴的，连勇者都觉得毛骨悚然，令人害怕的厚实铠甲。这样的珍贵物品并非轻易就能得到。

name: Phantom Greaves
description: Myths abound about armored phantoms that terrorized brave heroes. These greaves look just like the ones they supposedly wore. They're a rather rare find.
obtained:
Phantom Greaves are a piece of Armor exclusive to The Master Trials Downloadable Content pack. Obtaining them is one part of the objective of the "EX Treasure: Phantasma" Side Quest. The Greaves were stolen from Hyrule Castle by Misko and a clue to their location can be found in Misko's EX Journal at the Outpost Ruins. The Treasure Chest that hides the Phantom Greaves can be found buried in the southeast of the Hyrule Garrison Ruins near a ruined Guardian Stalker. After obtaining the Phantom Greaves, Granté will begin selling them for 50 Rupees.
According to its description, the Phantom Greaves look just like the Greaves supposedly worn by Phantoms that tormented heroes. When worn, the Phantom Greaves provide one level of Attack Up. The Phantom Greaves cannot be enhanced by a Great Fairy nor can they be Dyed at the Kochi Dye Shop. The Phantom Greaves, alongside the Phantom Helmet and Phantom Armor, compose the Phantom Equipment.
obtained_zh:
幻影护腿是《大师试炼》下载内容包独有的装备。获得它们是“EX宝藏：幻影”支线任务的一部分。这些护腿被米斯科从海拉鲁城堡偷走，在据点废墟中的米斯科的日记中可以找到线索。隐藏着幻影护腿的宝箱位于海拉鲁要塞废墟的东南方向，靠近一座破损的守卫者。获得幻影护腿后，格兰特会以50卢比的价格出售它们。

根据描述，幻影护腿与那些困扰英雄的幻影所穿的护腿一模一样。 佩戴幻影护腿后，可以获得1点攻击力提升。 幻影护腿不能被伟大的仙女增强，也不能在科奇染色店进行染色。 幻影护腿、幻影头盔和幻影铠甲组成了幻影装备。
description_zh: 据说是以前甲胄怪物所戴的，连勇者都觉得毛骨悚然，令人害怕的护胫。这样的珍贵物品并非轻易就能得到。

name: Phantom Helmet
description: Myths abound about armored phantoms that terrorized brave heroes. This helmet looks just like the ones they supposedly wore. It's a rather rare find.
obtained: The Phantom Helmet is a piece of Armor exclusive to The Master Trials DLC Pack. Obtaining it is one part of the objective of the "EX Treasure: Phantasma" Side Quest. The Helmet was stolen from Hyrule Castle by Misko and a clue to its location can be found in Misko's EX Journal at the Outpost Ruins. The Treasure Chest that hides the Phantom Helmet can be found buried near a wall on the first floor of the Coliseum Ruins. After obtaining the Phantom Helmet, Granté will begin selling it for 50 Rupees. According to its description, the Phantom Helmet looks just like the Helmets supposedly worn by Phantoms that tormented heroes. When worn, the Helmet provides one level of Attack Up. The Phantom Helmet cannot be enhanced by a Great Fairy nor can it be Dyed at the Kochi Dye Shop. The Phantom Helmet, alongside the Phantom Armor and Phantom Greaves, compose the Phantom Equipment.
obtained_zh: “幽灵头盔”是《大师试炼》DLC独有的装备。获得它，是完成任务“EX宝藏：幻影”支线任务的一部分。 Misko 从海拉鲁城堡偷走这个头盔。在Outpost Ruins（据点废墟）的 Misko 的 EX 记录中可以找到线索。 隐藏着幽灵头盔的宝箱位于 Colosseum Ruins（竞技场废墟）一楼的一面墙旁。获得幽灵头盔后，Granté 将以 50 卢比的价格出售。 根据描述，“幽灵头盔”与那些曾经困扰英雄的“幽灵”们佩戴的头盔非常相似。 佩戴后，可以提升一级攻击力。 幽灵头盔不能通过大妖精强化，也无法在 Kochi Dye Shop（古奇染色店）进行染色。 幽灵头盔、幽灵铠甲和幽灵护腿，组成“幽灵装备”。
description_zh: 据说是以前甲胄怪物所戴的，连勇者都觉得毛骨悚然，令人害怕的头盔。这样的珍贵物品并非轻易就能得到。

name: Radiant Mask
description: A mask made from crushed luminous stones that gives off a radiant glow in the dark.
obtained_zh:
“光辉面具”是一件护甲，可在格鲁多秘密俱乐部（在完成支线任务《秘密俱乐部的秘密》后）购买。 这件护甲由来自“发光石”的“哈特诺染料”制成，在夜晚佩戴时会发出骨骼图案的光芒。“光辉面具”可被大仙增强，并在科奇染料店染色。 此外，“光辉面具”、“光辉衬衫”和“光辉长裤”构成了“光辉套装”。

当每个“光辉套装”的物品都被大仙增强至少两次，且整个套装佩戴时，会提供“伪装”和“骨骼攻击力提升”的套装奖励。 类似于千龙出售的面具， “光辉套装”允许林克与斯塔洛宾、斯塔姆兽以及斯塔利扎尔融合。“此外，“光辉套装”还会使使用骨制武器（如龙之矛）造成的伤害增加。
description_zh: 绘有骨骼形状图案的面罩。使用了以夜光石为原料的稀有染料。在黑暗中会发出朦胧的光，满满的诡异。

name: Radiant Shirt
description: A shirt that glows in the dark due to dye made from luminous stones.
obtained_zh:
“光辉套装”：一种可在格鲁多小镇的“格鲁多秘密俱乐部”中购买，完成后需要完成“秘密俱乐部的秘密”支线的护甲。使用来自发光的石头制成的“哈特诺染料”，在夜晚穿着时，套装上的骨骼图案会发光。可以通过大仙提升，“光辉套装”和“光辉面具”、“光辉紧身衣”共同组成“光辉套装”。

当每个“光辉套装”的各部件都至少被大仙提升两次，并且完整套装穿上后，将获得“伪装”和“骨骼攻击力提升”的套装加成。类似于Kilton在“獠牙与骨头”中出售的面具， “光辉套装”允许林克融入Stalkoblins、Stalmoblins和Stalizalfos。此外，“光辉套装”还会增强使用骨制武器（如龙骨Boko俱乐部）造成的攻击，从而造成更高的伤害。
description_zh: 涂有使用夜光石制成的染料的紧身服。乍一看没有什么特别，但仅在黑暗中时，染料会发光，浮现出骨骼形状。

name: Radiant Tights
description: Paint made from crushed luminous stones causes these tights to glow in the dark.
obtained_zh:
“辉光紧身衣”是一件可以通过在格鲁多秘密俱乐部（需完成“秘密俱乐部的秘密”支线任务后）购买的盔甲。它由来自发光的石头制作的哈特诺染料制成，夜间穿着时，骨骼标记会发出光芒。“辉光紧身衣”可以被大仙增强，并在科奇染色店进行染色。“辉光紧身衣”与其他“辉光面具”和“辉光上衣”一起构成“辉光套装”。

当该套装中的每件装备都至少被大仙增强两次，且全套装备时，会提供“伪装”和“骨骼攻击增益”的套装效果。类似于芬格与骨店（Fang and Bone）出售的面具，“辉光套装”允许林克融入斯塔洛本、斯坦姆博林和斯塔利泽拉斯。此外，“辉光套装”使使用骨制武器（如龙骨博戈俱乐部）造成的攻击造成更高的伤害。
description_zh: 涂有夜光石经研磨萃取获得的特殊染料的紧身裤，在黑暗中会发出诡异的光，浮现出骨骼一样的形状。

name: Ravio's Hood
description: The hood of a traveling merchant who had a bracelet that could turn the wearer into a painting. Wearing it increases your sideways climbing speed. It's a rather rare find.
obtained:
Ravio's Hood is a piece of clothing worn by Ravio in A Link Between Worlds. It is worn to mask his identity as Link's Lorulean counterpart. Ravio removes his Hood after Link defeats Yuga Ganon, pleading for Hilda to give up her attempt to steal Hyrule's Triforce.

Ravio's Hood is a piece of Armor introduced in the "EX Treasure: Merchant Hood" Side Quest from The Champions' Ballad Downloadable Content pack in Breath of the Wild. It is a priceless relic that was once kept safely within the walls of Hyrule Castle, but was later stolen by Misko. Misko hints at the whereabouts of Ravio's Hood in Misko's EX Journal 2 in the Deya Village Ruins, claiming that it rests in the right hand of a dragon near Dracozu Lake. The Treasure Chest housing Ravio's Hood can be found embedded in the ground beneath the right hand of the dragon statue at the Spring of Courage. In order to retrieve it, Link must use the Magnesis Rune to pull it from the ground.
Ravio's Hood is the same Hood worn by Ravio. When worn, it grants Link the Sideways Climbing Speed Increased Added Effect, which increases his sideways Climbing speed. If Link sells Ravio's Hood, he can later purchase it from Granté at Tarrey Town for 50 Rupees. Ravio's Hood cannot be enhanced by a Great Fairy, nor can it be Dyed at the Kochi Dye Shop.
obtained_zh:
拉维的斗篷是《塞尔达传说：旷野之息》中拉维穿着的一件服装。他佩戴它以隐藏自己作为林克的罗鲁族身份。在林克击败尤加·加农后，拉维向希尔达请求放弃偷取赫鲁地区的三角三宝的企图。

《塞尔达传说：旷野之息》中的“EX 宝藏：商人斗篷”支线任务，原为拉维的斗篷。这是一件无价文物，曾被妥善保管在赫鲁城堡内，但后来被米斯科盗走。米斯科在德亚村遗迹中的“米斯科 EX 日记 2”中暗示了斗篷的位置，声称斗篷位于勇气之泉附近的龙身像的右手。通过使用“磁力”符文，林克可以将位于龙身像右手的宝箱中的拉维斗篷从地面上取回。
拉维斗篷是真正的斗篷。在佩戴时，它将为林克提供“攀爬速度增加”的效果，从而提高他的侧向攀爬速度。如果林克出售了拉维斗篷，他可以在塔雷小镇的格兰特处以50卢比的价格再次购买。拉维斗篷无法被圣灵增强，也无法在科奇染色店进行染色。
description_zh: 戴上神奇手镯就能变成壁画的旅行商人的头巾。虽然这个无法变成壁画，但横向攀爬速度很快。这样的珍品并非轻易就能得到。

《旷野：王之密令》

“王之密令”任务（仅限《英雄传说：下载版》）中获得皇家卫兵帽。在主线任务中，玩家需要阅读位于 riverside stable 的 Super Rumor Mill V4。Traysi 声称，皇家卫兵套装的碎片可在 Dining Hall （靠近 Guards' Chamber）、以及 Sanctum of Hyrule Castle 的第二层分布。

name: Rubber Armor
description: This armor owes its electricity resistance to an ancient material called "rubber," which is nearly impossible to find.
obtained_zh: 橡胶盔甲可在“雷霆试炼”神殿任务完成后，在土雅峡谷的神殿获得。它为林克提供3点防御和1级电击抗性。可由大仙增强并于柯奇染色店染色。橡胶盔甲、橡胶头盔和橡胶紧身裤组成同名的套装——《橡胶装备》。当每个部件均已通过大仙增强至少两次，且整个套装佩戴时，则获得“无电击效果”套装奖励。
description_zh: 具有耐电性能的珍贵紧身服。由活用了古代技术的橡胶这种现代没有的特殊材料制作而成。能够覆盖住身体。

name: Rubber Helm
description: An electricity-resistant helmet made from an ancient material called "rubber."
obtained_zh: 橡胶头盔、橡胶护甲和橡胶紧身衣属于“橡胶套装”。可以通过在Lakeside Stable完成“闪电吸引”支线任务获得头盔。它为林克提供3层防御和一定程度的电击抵抗。完成任务后，可以从Tarrey Town的Granté处购买。
description_zh: 以古代技术制成的具有耐电性能的帽子。好像是用已失传的橡胶这种不容易导电的特殊材料制成的。

name: Rubber Tights
description: These invaluable tights are resistant to electricity. They're made with an ancient technology called "rubber."
obtained: The Rubber Tights can be found in the Horon Lagoon Cave.
obtained_zh: 橡胶紧身裤可在霍隆湖洞穴中找到。
description_zh: 具有耐电性能的珍贵紧身裤。由使用了古代技术的橡胶这种材料制作而成，在现代则制作不了。

name: Ruby Circlet
description: A traditional Gerudo headpiece set with a ruby, which uses the power of fire to make the cold more bearable.
obtained_zh:
红宝石项链是一种头饰，装备在林克的头上。可在格鲁多镇的“星光回忆珠宝店”购买，价格为500卢比和三个红宝石。或者，在“工具专攻”支线任务结束时，伊莎会作为奖励将红宝石项链赠送给链接。佩戴后，红宝石项链可以为林克提供1级的寒冷抗性。同时，还拥有隐藏效果：提高古老兵器的伤害20%。
红宝石项链可以在“大妖精之泉”处由大妖精强化，但不能在“科奇染色店”染色。
description_zh: 由格鲁德的宝石工匠打造的传统头饰。因蕴含火之力量的红宝石加护，戴在头上就会发挥耐寒效果。

name: Sand Boots
description: These Gerudo-made boots evenly distribute your weight so you can maintain your normal movement speed on sand.
obtained_zh:
沙靴提供“沙地加速”效果，使林克能够在沙地区域（如格鲁多沙漠或海滩）更快移动。 还可以与格鲁多上衣和格鲁多披风一起穿着在格鲁多镇中使用。
要获得沙靴，林克需要与博赛对话，他可以在格鲁多镇跑步。 林克需要穿好完整的“格鲁多服装”来开始名为《第八位英雄》的支线任务。 在此任务中，林克将暂时获得雪靴。 一旦林克到达格鲁多高原并拍摄“第八位英雄”雕像的照片，他必须向博赛展示。 林克将换回雪靴，并获得沙靴。 之后，格兰特将在塔雷镇开始出售沙靴。
沙靴并非完成游戏任务的必要物品，但林克可以获得后开启《遗忘之剑》任务。
description_zh: 据说是以前格鲁德族使用的珍贵靴子。拥有难以陷入沙中的鞋底，装备后，即使在沙漠，移动速度也丝毫不减。

name: Sapphire Circlet
description: A Gerudo headpiece set with a sapphire, which harnesses the power of ice to make the heat more bearable.
obtained_zh:
蓝宝石项链是一种头盔饰品，可佩戴在头上。可以在格鲁多的星光回忆珠宝店购买，价格为800卢比和三个蓝宝石。或者，在“匠人工具”支线任务的结尾，伊莎会作为奖励给予链接的是一个蓝宝石项链。佩戴后，可以提供Link 1层热耐性。同时，还可以获得隐藏效果：20%的古代士兵装备和守护者装备伤害增加。

蓝宝石项链可以在大仙泉处通过大仙强化。但是，不能在 Kochi染料店进行染色。
description_zh: 以格鲁德的雕金技术制作而成的精巧头饰。据说蓝宝石蕴含着冰之力量，装备后因其加护，会发挥耐热效果。

name: Sheik's Mask
description: A mask said to have been worn by a Sheikah who saved a time-traveling hero. Ideal for undercover work.
obtained: Sheik's Mask is a piece of Armor which can be obtained by completing the Desert Coliseum. Sheik's Mask can also be obtained by using the amiibo Ancient Power. Wearing Sheik's Mask will provide Link Stealth Up.
obtained_zh: 《SHEIK的面具》是一件装备，可通过完成沙漠竞技场获得。也可通过使用Ancient Power amiibo获得。佩戴《SHEIK的面具》可使Link获得隐身效果。
description_zh: 据说是希卡族所佩戴的面罩，他们帮助过一个穿越时空而来的勇者。静音性能好。用的是希卡之布，最适合隐秘行动。

name: Snow Boots
description: These boots distribute your body weight so you can maintain your normal movement speed on deep snow.
obtained_zh:
雪靴提供“雪速”效果，让林克在雪地中更快移动。可以与“格鲁多面纱”和“格鲁多上衣”一起穿在格鲁多的城镇里。
要获得它们，林克必须穿上“格鲁多套装”，并在格鲁多的城镇外与博赛交谈。通过接受“第八位女英雄”支线任务，他将暂时获得雪靴。完成支线任务后，林克可以将雪靴换成沙漠靴。之后，林克可以通过再次与博赛交谈并完成“遗忘之剑”支线任务来永久获取雪靴。一旦获得它们，格兰特会在塔雷镇开始出售雪靴。
雪靴可以在大仙泉升级，并在可基染色店进行染色。
description_zh: 据说是从前登雪山时使用的珍贵靴子。它在分散体重上被下了很大的功夫，装备后，即使是厚厚的积雪上，移动速度也丝毫不减。

name: Snowquill Headdress
description: A Rito accessory made from snow-bird feathers. Adorned with a gem that harnesses the power of fire.
obtained: Link can wear the Snowquill Headdress in Tears of the Kingdom.
obtained_zh: 在《塞尔达传说：王国之泪》中，林可以佩戴“雪羽头饰”。
description_zh: 由雪鸟的优质羽毛和蕴含火之力量的红宝石搭配而成的利特族羽饰。戴在身上就会有加强防寒的效果。

name: Snowquill Tunic
description: Made by Rito artisans, this tunic stacks molted Rito feathers in each layer to help retain body heat.
obtained: Link can wear the Snowquill Tunic in Tears of the Kingdom.
obtained_zh: 链接可以在《塞尔达传说：王国之泪》中穿戴“雪羽长袍”。
description_zh: 为了去访问塔邦挞和海布拉的海利亚人，而用利特族换下来的羽毛制成的衣服。里面重叠着好几层羽毛，保暖性强。

name: Snowquill Trousers
description: The Rito feathers that line these trousers make them excellent at retaining body heat.
obtained: Link can wear the Snowquill Trousers in Tears of the Kingdom.
obtained_zh: 林可以穿“雪羽裤”在《塞尔达传说：王国之泪》中。
description_zh: 用利特族换下来的羽毛制成的裤子。内层布料装有羽毛，保暖性强。在利特村是面向海利亚人出售的。

name: Soldier's Armor
description: Hyrulean guards praised this sturdy armor for its superior defense. Its craftsmanship is obvious.
obtained_zh: 士兵套装包括：士兵盔甲、头盔和护腿。可在哈特诺村购买。由一副肩甲、一副手套和一件胸甲组成，均由钢铁制成。除了增加防御之外，没有其他效果。可在 Kochi 染料店进行染色，并可由巨灵仙女增强。
description_zh: 海利亚士兵装备的铠甲。由金属板加工而成，高防御力是其特点。从坚固的装甲上可以看出工匠的高超技术。

name: Soldier's Greaves
description: Greaves favored by Hyrulean guards. They owe their distinctly high defense to the metal plates they're made from.
obtained_zh: 士兵护腿可在Hateno村的Ventest服装店购买。它是“士兵套装”的一部分，包括士兵头盔和士兵铠甲。穿着后，防御力提升。士兵护腿可以被大仙增强，并在Kochi染料店染色。
description_zh: 海利亚士兵装备的护胫。由坚固的金属加工而成，高防御力是其特点。因为有一定的重量，所以装备它奔跑需要习惯下。

name: Soldier's Helm
description: Sturdy headgear for protecting frontline soldiers from vicious monsters. Praised for its superior defense.
obtained_zh: 士兵头盔是士兵套装的一部分，与士兵战甲和士兵靴一起使用。在哈特诺村的“万德服装店”可以购买。可以在“科奇染料店”染色，并在大精灵泉处升级。仅提供防御效果。
description_zh: 保护最前线战斗士兵的头盔。它由金属制成十分坚固，高防御力是其特点。现有的头盔是大灾厄时完好无损保留下来的。

name: Stealth Chest Guard
description: Armor designed for stealth, passed down through the Sheikah tribe. Its special fabric suppresses sound.
obtained_zh: 隐形胸甲：可在卡卡里村的“神秘商店”购买。描述称，该防具使用希凯亚布料可减少衣物摩擦声。佩戴时，提供1级隐身效果。可通过“大精灵”强化，并在“科奇染料店”染色。与隐形面罩和隐形紧身裤一同构成“隐形套装”。当每个物品至少由“大精灵”强化两次，且整个套装佩戴时，可获得“夜间加速套装效果”。
description_zh: 希卡族留传下来的隐秘紧身服。使用能够抑制衣服摩擦声的材料，即使快速行动，也不会产生杂音。

name: Stealth Mask
description: A Sheikah-made mask that suppresses the noisy rustling of clothes. Perfect for sneaking about.
obtained_zh:
隐匿面罩是可在卡卡里克村的“魔法”商店购买的盔甲。根据描述，面罩采用石神工艺，可以抑制衣物的窸窣声。佩戴时提供一层隐匿效果。隐匿面罩可由大妖精强化，并可在“科奇染料店”染色。与隐匿胸甲和隐匿紧身裤一起构成“隐匿套装”。当套装中的每件物品被大妖精强化至少两次，且完整套装佩戴时，会获得“夜间加速套装效果”。

染色选项
description_zh: 看着像是普通的织布面罩，但其实是采用希卡族的技术，对彻底抑制衣服摩擦的声音下了一番功夫。最适合隐秘行动。

name: Stealth Tights
description: Tights crafted by the Sheikah, laced with ancient technology that suppresses the noisy rustling of clothes.
obtained_zh: 隐匿紧身衣：可在卡卡里克村的“魔法商店”购买。据描述，这些紧身衣采用的压音布是古代的舍伊克技术标志。穿着后，提供一次隐蔽效果加成。隐匿紧身衣可由伟大的仙子强化，并在古奇染料店染色。与隐匿面罩和隐匿护甲一起，构成“隐匿套装”。当每个套装部件都经过伟大的仙子的两次强化，完整套装穿着时，获得“夜间加速效果加成"。
description_zh: 希卡族隐秘行动时使用的紧身裤。由使用古代技术的布料制作而成，能够尽量抑制衣服摩擦的声音。

name: Tingle's Hood
description: There was once a man who claimed to be the very reincarnation of a fairy. He treasured this hood, and so will you. After all, it's a rather rare find. Kooloo-Limpah.
obtained:
Tingle's Hood is a piece of Armor that Link can wear on his head. It is exclusive to The Master Trials Downloadable Content Pack. Alongside Tingle's Shirt and Tingle's Tights, it is part of the Tingle's Outfit Armor Set. When all pieces are worn together, Link's speed at night will be increased.
Tingle's Hood was stolen from Hyrule Castle with other pieces of Tingle's Outfit by Misko. During the "EX Treasure: Fairy Clothes" Side Quest, Link is tasked with finding Misko's EX Journal to learn where it has been hidden. In the Journal, the Hood is said to be within the "ruins where trade flourished. At the Outpost Ruins, Link can find a Hidden Chest embedded in the ground, which contains Tingle's Hood.
After obtaining Tingle's Hood, Granté will begin to sell it from 50 Rupees in Tarrey Town. Tingle's Hood is unable to be Dyed at the Kochi Dye Shop or upgraded at a Great Fairy Fountain.
obtained_zh:
Tingle的斗篷是Link可以佩戴在头上的一件盔甲，属于《塞尔达传说：时之泪》下载内容包。与Tingle的衬衫和Tingle的连裤袜一起，构成Tingle的套装装备。当所有部件同时穿戴时，Link在夜晚的速度会增加。
Misko偷走了Tingle的其他部件，包括Tingle的斗篷，从海拉鲁城堡带走。在支线任务“EX宝藏：精灵服装”中，Link需要找到Misko的EX日志，以了解斗篷的具体藏匿地点。在该日志中，斗篷被描述为位于“贸易繁荣的废墟”内。在Outpost废墟，Link可以找到一个埋在地下的隐藏箱子，其中包含Tingle的斗篷。
获得Tingle的斗篷后，Granté将在Tarrey Town以50卢比的价格出售。Tingle的斗篷不能在Kochi染料店染色或在伟大仙女之泉进行升级。
description_zh: 向往成为妖精的男子所爱佩戴的头巾。好像对于那个男子来说，绿色是妖精的象征。貌似这样的物品并非轻易就能得到。

name: Tingle's Shirt
description: There was once a man who claimed to be the very reincarnation of a fairy. He treasured this shirt, and so will you. After all, it's a rather rare find. Kooloo-Limpah.
obtained: Tingle's Shirt can be found as part of the Side Quest "EX Treasure: Fairy Clothes" exclusive to The Master Trials Downloadable Content Pack. It can be found inside a Hidden Chest buried in the ruins of the Castle Town Prison, which can be lifted from the ground with Magnesis. After obtaining it, Granté will begin to sell Tingle's Shirt in Tarrey Town. It's part of Tingle's Outfit along with Tingle's Hood and Tingle's Tights. Tingle's Shirt offers no additional effects on its own or as part of a set. It cannot be enhanced by a Great Fairy, nor can it be Dyed at the Kochi Dye Shop.
obtained_zh: 《丁格尔的衬衫》可在独家下载内容包“EX宝藏：仙女服装”中的支线任务中获得。它位于城堡镇监狱废墟中的隐藏箱子里，可通过磁力道具从地面挖掘出来。获得后，格兰特会在塔雷镇出售《丁格尔的衬衫》。它是《丁格尔套装》的一部分，包括《丁格尔帽》和《丁格尔紧身裤》。单独或作为套装，《丁格尔的衬衫》没有任何额外效果。无法被大仙王强化，也无法在科奇染料店染色。
description_zh: 向往成为妖精的男子所爱穿的衣服。好像对于那个男子来说，绿色是妖精的象征。貌似这样的物品并非轻易就能得到。

name: Tingle's Tights
description: There was once a man who claimed to be the very reincarnation of a fairy. He treasured these tights, and so will you. After all, they're a rather rare find. Kooloo-Limpah.
obtained:
The Tingle Tights are an Outfit in Tri Force Heroes that can be crafted at Madame Couture's after Link has completed the Forest Temple. The Outfit dresses Link in Tingle's signature bodysuit, complete with his clock pendant, rosy cheeks, and facial hair and mole.
Wearers of the Tingle Tights begin each Level with three balloons tied to their waists. These balloons save the wearer from losing Health or failing the "Don't fall at all!" Drablands Challenge when falling off ledges. This ability works up to three times per Level, as one balloon will pop after each fall. The ability also works for falling into Lava, but not for falling into Quicksand.

Tingle's Tights are only available when The Master Trials Downloadable Content pack is active. After beginning the "EX Treasure: Fairy Clothes" Side Quest, Tingle's Tights can be found in the Mabe Village Ruins. They are part of Tingle's Outfit, along with Tingle's Shirt and Tingle's Hood. Wearing the full Armor Set will give Link the Night Speed Up Set Bonus.
obtained_zh:
在《三力英雄》中，Tingle Tights 是一个服装，可以在 Madame Couture 手中制作。完成森林神殿后，该服装会给 Link 穿上 Tingle 的标志性连体衣，包括他的时钟吊坠、红润的脸颊和胡须及雀斑。

穿着 Tingle Tights 的玩家会在每个关卡开始时携带三个连接在腰部的气球。这些气球可以防止玩家从悬崖上掉落时失去生命值或失败"绝对不要掉下来！"的 Drablands 挑战。这个能力可以在每个关卡中使用三次，每次掉落后一个气球都会爆破。该能力也可以用于掉入熔岩，但不能用于掉入沙地沼泽。

Tingle's Tights 只有在《大师试炼》下载内容包处于激活状态时才能获得。在开始"EX Treasure: Fairy Clothes" 支线任务后，可以在 Mabe Village Ruins 中找到 Tingle's Tights。它们是 Tingle 的套装的一部分，包括 Tingle 的衬衫和 Tingle 的帽子。穿上完整的盔甲套件会使 Link 获得夜间加速效果。
description_zh: 向往成为妖精的男子所爱穿的裤子。好像对于那个男子来说，绿色是妖精的象征。貌似这样的物品并非轻易就能得到。

name: Topaz Earrings
description: Earrings made with topaz, which harnesses the power of lightning to increase electricity resistance.
obtained_zh:
托帕石耳环是一种饰品，特别是可以佩戴在林克的耳朵上的耳环。可在格鲁多镇的“星光回忆珠宝店”购买，价格为500卢比和五个托帕斯。 也可以在旁支任务《工匠技艺》中，伊莎给予林克作为奖励的一种饰品是托帕石耳环。 佩戴后，托帕石耳环为林克提供一层电击抗性。 同时还具有隐藏效果，使使用古代士兵装备和守卫装备时的伤害提升20%。
托帕石耳环可以在大仙泉处由大仙强化。 但不能在科奇染料店进行染色。
description_zh: 格鲁德的宝石工匠将据说蕴含着雷之力量的黄玉加工成耳坠。戴上之后因其加护，会发挥耐电效果。

name: Trousers of Awakening
description: Legend says these trousers were worn by a hero who explored a mysterious island that one could visit but not leave.
obtained_zh: 优化
description_zh: 据说某位勇者曾前往一座进入后就无法再离开的神奇岛屿冒险，这是他所穿的裤子。让人又想一直穿着，又想快点脱下来。

name: Trousers of Time
description: Legends say these trousers were once worn by a hero who traveled through time.
obtained: The Trousers of Time can be found inside a Treasure Chest in the Gerudo Canyon Mine.
obtained_zh: 时间裤位于格鲁多的峡谷矿坑中的宝箱内。
description_zh: 据说是穿越时空而来的勇者所穿的裤子。好像这裤子原本是森林居民制作的衣物。

name: Trousers of Twilight
description: Legends say these trousers were once worn by a hero who battled the beasts of twilight.
obtained: The Trousers of Twilight are found inside a Stone Chest in the Ancient Underground Fortress in the Akkala Highlands Depths.
obtained_zh: “暮色裤”位于阿卡拉高原深处的古代地下堡垒内的石箱中。
description_zh: 据说是和黄昏怪物战斗的勇者所穿的裤子。内层沾有稍许狼毛。

name: Trousers of the Hero
description: Legends say these trousers were favored by a hero from an ancient age.
obtained: Corvash Canyon Mine
obtained_zh: 科尔瓦什峡谷矿山
description_zh: 据说是古代勇者爱穿的裤子。虽然制作简朴，但在设计上也是别有一番风味的精品。

name: Trousers of the Sky
description: Legends say these trousers were once worn by a hero who appeared from the sky riding a mighty bird.
obtained: Crenel Canyon Mine
obtained_zh: 克伦尔峡谷矿山
description_zh: 据说是乘着大鸟从空中出现的勇者经常穿着的裤子。这裤子好像是骑士团的制服。

name: Trousers of the Wild
description: Legends say these trousers were tailored for a hero who travels the wilderness.
obtained_zh:
《旷野之息》

《野外裤》是一件装备，可在“修道士的礼物”支线任务中获得。在完成所有120个古神殿（不包括需要完成的“冠军之歌EX”主线任务中的16个），修道士会告诉林克前往遗忘神殿，在那里他可以在后方的女神雕像前找到三个石制宝箱。右边的宝箱里有《野外裤》。《野外裤》可以通过大仙进行强化和染色（在Kochi染色店）。与《野外帽子》和《野外背心》一起，《野外裤》构成“野外套装”。当每个装备至少被大仙强化两次，且完整套装佩戴时，会获得“贤者之剑Beam Up”套装奖励。

《王国之泪》
description_zh: 据说是为旷野之旅的勇者量身定做的裤子。尺寸正正好好，穿着十分舒适。

name: Trousers of the Wind
description: Legends say these trousers were once cherished by a hero who sailed the Great Sea.
obtained: Cresia Pit Mine
obtained_zh: 克雷西亚矿山
description_zh: 据说是在大海上旅行的勇者爱穿的裤子。不管被水淋湿了多少，也都没事。

name: Tunic of Awakening
description: Legend says this armor was worn by a hero who explored a mysterious area that one could visit but not leave.
obtained_zh: 提升
description_zh: 据说某位勇者曾前往一座进入后就无法再离开的神奇岛屿冒险，这是他所穿的绿色衣服。让人又想一直穿着，又想快点脱下来。

name: Tunic of Memories
description: In ancient Hyrule, only those respected by the royal family could wear this garment.
obtained: The Tunic of Memories is a recreation of the Champion's Tunic crafted by the combined power of the Bargainer Statues after Link has encountered all seven of them. It can be purchased for 400 Poes, and cannot be sold. It shares the same design as the Champion's Tunic, but has an overall lower Defense, altered upgrade requirements, and the hidden effect Master Sword Beam Always Available, which allows Link to fire beams from the Master Sword regardless of his current Hearts. It does not reveal Enemy health values above their Life Gauge.
obtained_zh: 记忆长袍是“冠军长袍”的复制品，由在林克与所有七个“交易者雕像”相遇后，它们的联合力量所创造。可以以400 Poes的价格购买，不能出售。外观与“冠军长袍”相同，但整体防御较低，升级要求不同，并且具有隐藏效果“大师之剑光”，允许林克在任何生命值状态下都能使用大师之剑发射子弹。它不会显示敌人的生命值高于其生命值条的值。
description_zh: 从前受海拉鲁王族认可的五位英杰所穿的衣服，由鲜亮的蓝色染成。

name: Tunic of Time
description: Legend has it this armor was worn by a hero who traveled through time. It can be worn by a child or an adult.
obtained_zh:
《旷野：拯救者》

《王国：传承》
description_zh: 据说是穿越时空而来的勇者所穿的绿色衣服。这个设计适合任何年龄段的人穿着。

name: Tunic of Twilight
description: Legend has it this armor was worn by a hero who battled monsters of twilight.
obtained: The Tunic of Twilight is found inside a Stone Chest in Rist Mine in the Akkala Sea Depths.
obtained_zh: 在阿卡拉海深区的瑞斯矿穴内，有一个石棺，里面藏着“暮色长袍”。
description_zh: 据说是和黄昏怪物战斗的勇者所穿的绿色衣服。仔细看还沾有稍许狼毛。

name: Tunic of the Depths
description: A tunic acquired by offering Poes to a strange statue found in the Depths. It offers some resistance to gloom.
obtained: The Tunic of the Depths can be bought from a Bargainer Statue for 150 Poes. It only becomes available after Link has interacted with two different Bargainer Statues. When worn, it provides Gloom Resistance.
obtained_zh: “深渊之袍”可在商人雕像处购买，价格为150个宝。只有在链接与两个不同的商人雕像互动后才会出现。穿上后，提供“暗影抵抗”。
description_zh: 通过向奇异雕像奉献魄而获得的衣服。布料中织入了怪物材料，因此可以些许阻挡瘴气的影响。

name: Tunic of the Hero
description: Legend has it this armor was once cherished by a hero from ancient times.
obtained: Dueling Canyons Mine
obtained_zh: 杜灵峡谷矿坑
description_zh: 据说是古代勇者爱穿的绿色衣服。虽然设计简单，但是一款具有传统感的精品。

name: Tunic of the Sky
description: Legend has it this armor was worn by a hero who rode a mighty bird. It was apparently presented after a ceremonious event.
obtained: Minshi Grove
obtained_zh: 迷你谷
description_zh: 据说是乘着大鸟从空中出现的勇者经常穿着的绿色衣服。传说这是庆祝仪式的赠品。

name: Tunic of the Wild
description: This armor was apparently crafted for a hero who travels the wilds. Interestingly, it's just your size.
obtained_zh:
《旷野之息》

“野之袍”是一件防具，可在支线任务《神僧的礼物》中获得。完成所有120个古代神殿（不包括需要在主线《勇者颂》中完成的16个神殿），最终神殿的神僧会告诉林克前往遗忘之寺，在那里他会在神殿后部的女神雕像前找到三个石质宝箱，其中一个宝箱内包含“野之袍”。“野之袍”可以被大精灵增强，并在 Kochi 染料店进行染色。与“野之帽”和“野之裤”一起，“野之套装”构成完整的装备。当每个装备至少被大精灵增强两次，且完整套装被佩戴时，会获得“真剑向上攻击”套装奖励。

《狂野的眼泪》
description_zh: 据说是为旷野之旅的勇者量身定做的绿色衣服。穿上后，尺寸非常合适。

name: Tunic of the Wind
description: Legend has it this armor was worn by a hero who sailed the Great Sea. It was woven with love by his grandmother.
obtained: Cuho Canyon Mine
obtained_zh: 库霍峡谷矿山
description_zh: 据说是在大海上旅行的勇者爱穿的绿色衣服。传说这是祖母送给他的礼物。

name: Vah Medoh Divine Helm
description: A helm said to deepen the bond with the Rito when worn by a Hylian.
obtained_zh:
精髓：
《旷野：传唱》
《传唱2》
description_zh: 自古以来，守护利特人民的战士拥有的头盔。据说海利亚人只要戴上它，就能加深与利特族的联系。

name: Vah Naboris Divine Helm
description: A helm said to deepen the bond with the Gerudo when worn by a Hylian.
obtained: West Gerudo Underground Ruins
obtained_zh: 西格鲁德地下遗址
description_zh: 自古以来，守护格鲁德人民的战士拥有的头盔。据说海利亚人只要戴上它，就能加深与格鲁德族的联系。

name: Vah Rudania Divine Helm
description: A helm said to deepen the bond with the Gorons when worn by a Hylian.
obtained: The Vah Rudania Divine Helm is found in a Treasure Chest inside Lizard's Burrow.[verification needed]
obtained_zh: 瓦·鲁达尼亚神圣头盔，位于蜥蜴巢穴内的宝箱中。
description_zh: 自古以来，守护鼓隆人民的战士拥有的头盔。据说海利亚人只要戴上它，就能加深与鼓隆族的联系。

name: Vah Ruta Divine Helm
description: A helm said to deepen the bond with the Zora when worn by a Hylian.
obtained: Wearing the Vah Ruta Divine Helm causes Sidon's Sage Avatar to wear a similar helmet.
obtained_zh: 佩戴“维哈·鲁塔”圣盔后，西顿的圣阿瓦塔也会佩戴类似的头盔。
description_zh: 自古以来，守护卓拉人民的战士拥有的头盔。据说海利亚人只要戴上它，就能加深与卓拉族的联系。

name: Well-Worn Hair Band
description: An old, worn, simple hair band. Its color has long faded, but it still has someliife left in it.
obtained: The Well-Worn Hair Band is found in Zelda's Secret Well in Hateno Village. It does not provide any defense, but it instead ties Link's hair back in the same hairstyle he wore in Breath of the Wild. It is the only Armor piece that provides no defense.
obtained_zh: 位于哈特诺村的“Zelda的秘密井”中，可以找到“饱经使用的发带”。它不提供任何防具效果，而是让林克保持与《旷野之息》中相同的发型。它是唯一一件不提供防具的装备。
description_zh: 陈旧且朴素的发夹，虽已然褪色，但依旧可以使用。用它夹头发的话，会感到莫名的怀念。

name: Yiga Armor
description: Armor supplied to members of the Yiga Clan. Defensive parts are minimized for silence, so it's lacking in protection.
obtained: Akkala Ancient Tech Lab
obtained_zh: 阿卡拉古代科技实验室
description_zh: 分配给依盖队队员的紧身服。设计上，将用于防护的零件减少至最低限度，以尽可能避免产生声响。防御力也因此低下。

name: Yiga Mask
description: A mask supplied to members of the Yiga Clan. It covers the entire face, keeping even breath sounds to a minimum. Perfect sneaking, but lacks protection due to its light material.
obtained_zh:
Yiga 面具是Yiga氏族所有活跃成员佩戴在脸上的。 它通过呈十字形的铁铆固定在头部的其余部分。 由于Blademasters通常会佩戴斗篷，因此无法在他们身上看到面具效果。 与面具一起附带两只铁耳环： Yiga 士兵是直线形； Yiga Blademasters 是弯曲的，以模仿獠牙； Master Kohga 的则是钩子形。 大多数面具都简单且呈椭圆形，但Master Kohga的面部有六根弯曲的角，每侧三个角，位于面具的上部。
Yiga 氏族掩体中央柱体的西侧，共有24个 Yiga 面具，呈两组6x2排列。 这些面具不可互动，仅用于外观效果。
description_zh: 分发给依盖队队员的面罩。面罩覆盖整张脸，甚至能减轻呼吸的声音。非常适合隐秘行动，但因用材较轻而防御力低下。

name: Yiga Tights
description: Tights supplied to members of the Yiga Clan. The soft material on the soles silences footsteps, but protection is lacking due to the light material.
obtained_zh: 奥尔多山麓·依盖队玛丽塔支部洞窟（大海拉鲁森林以西）：击败洞内依盖队成员，用通天术上到顶部密室，从获救的裁缝阿莉莎处获得。
description_zh: 分发给依盖队队员的紧身裤。脚掌处使用了柔软的材料，不易发出脚步声。因为用料较薄，防御力低下。

name: Zant's Helmet
description: The ruthless Usurper King of the Twilight Realm wore a helmet much like this one. It's a rather rare find.
obtained:
Zant's Helmet is located in a Gloom-cloaked Treasure Chest in the Scorching Coliseum. It cannot be retrieved unless all of the Enemies inside the Coliseum have been defeated. The location of Zant's Helmet is revealed by an Old Map found in the South Lanayru Sky Archipelago. Zant's Helmet can be retrieved without first finding the Old Map, however.
After it has been found in the Scorching Coliseum, it can also be purchased from a Bargainer Statue for 400 Poes.
obtained_zh: 赞特的头盔位于灼热竞技场的暗影宝箱中。除非击败竞技场内的所有敌人，否则无法获取。 通过在南兰埃鲁天空群岛找到的老地图可以找到赞特的头盔的位置。 但是，即使没有先找到老地图也可以获得。 在灼热竞技场内找到后，还可以用 400 Poes 从交易人雕像处购买。
description_zh: 据说是统治黄昏世界，因冷酷无情而令人畏惧的僭王所佩戴的头盔。这样的珍贵物品并非轻易就能得到。

name: Zonaite Helm
description: A helmet forged of zonaite. The magic infused into it during its production grants its weare improved energy efficiency for Zonai devices.
obtained: The Zonaite Helm is a piece of Armor that can be found on Lightcast Island in the Tabantha Frontier Sky. It is made from Zonaite and provides the Energy Up Added Effect when worn, reducing Energy Cell consumption. It also grants Soul Power Up Spirit, increasing the attack power of Mineru's Construct.
obtained_zh: 扎纳이트头盔，可在塔班塔前线天空中的光芒岛上找到。由扎纳াইট制成，佩戴时提供“能量提升”效果，降低能量细胞消耗。同时，还能给予“灵魂力量提升”，增加米尼的构造的攻击力。
description_zh: 以左纳尼乌姆加工制成的头盔。由于制作过程中注入的魔力，装备者在使用左纳乌装置之际，能源效率会提高。

name: Zonaite Shin Guards
description: Shin guards forged of zonaite. Wearing them awakens the magic of their creators, improving efficiency for Zonai devices.
obtained: Sky Mine
obtained_zh: 天坑矿业
description_zh: 以左纳尼乌姆加工制成的护膝。装备后，左纳乌族的名匠注入的魔力会生效，使用左纳乌装置之际的能源效率会提高。

name: Zonaite Waistguard
description: A waistguard made from zonait hile wearing it, you'll reap the benefit of its imbued magic and improve the effieiency of Zonai devices.
obtained: Zonaite Forge Island
obtained_zh: 佐奈特锻造岛屿
description_zh: 以左纳尼乌姆加工制成的前挂。穿在身上就可以受到注入其中的魔力带来的恩惠，从而能够更有效率地使用左纳乌装置。

name: Zora Armor
description: Armor crafted by a past Zora princess for her future husband. Equip it to swim up waterfalls.
obtained_zh:
在《时之界》中，泽拉的服饰使林克可以在水下呼吸。 它主要与铁靴一起使用，对于探索水宫至关重要。 与古龙的服饰不同，它不提供任何防御加成。 如果林克穿着它被喷出，则任何Zora都可以偷走这件衣服。
可以通过在泽拉商店购买（300卢比），也可以由国王泽拉赠送给林克，当他用蓝焰解冻林克时。
泽拉的服饰是由鱼鳃制成的，尽管外观上与游戏中其他服饰完全一样，颜色是唯一的区别。 泽拉为海拉王哈利安的水务部门提供了一些泽拉服饰，以帮助他们在泽拉河床中清理。

在《童年传说》中，林克从瑞露塔那里获得了泽拉盔甲，因为她成功地将拉利斯交给了卡卡里村。 它位于卡卡里村墓地的后方，位于国王泽拉的墓穴下。
穿着泽拉盔甲后，林克可以呼吸并游泳在水下。 与铁靴结合使用，林克可以在河流中行走很深。 然而，佩戴盔甲会使林克的受火和冰攻击伤害加倍。（包括掉入熔岩或冻结水中）
泽拉盔甲由泽拉鳞片制成（以鳞甲的形式），并且包含一个面罩，林克在水下时会将其戴在脸上。

在《旷野之声》中，泽拉的盔甲是泽拉公主和冠军米法专门为林克制作的一件礼物，以象征他们的爱。 林克于访问者域后100年，由国王多罗凡赠送给他。 如果林克的储物空间已满，他将在装下这件盔甲之后获得它。
穿着泽拉的盔甲可以提高游泳速度一级，并且使林克能够攀爬瀑布。 盔甲可以通过伟大的仙女强化，可以在科奇染色店染色。 泽拉的盔甲（以及泽拉头盔和泽拉靴）构成泽拉套装。 当每件套装都被伟大的仙女强化至少两次，并完整佩戴时，会获得游泳加速耐力加成。 然而，与其他盔甲不同，此套装无法出售，因为这套盔甲具有独特的故事情节。
盔甲由一个大型的胸甲、一套覆盖肩部和一部分林克后部的鳞甲、两个由钢铁制成的斜挎包以及由银和钢铁制成的手套组成。
description_zh: 倾注了已经过世的卓拉族公主心意的铠甲。只要穿上这具铠甲，海利亚人也可以攀瀑。

name: Zora Greaves
description: These greaves have been passed down among the Zora for generations. Equip them to swim faster.
obtained_zh:
洛法特将佐拉靴赠给林克，作为完成“猎狮”支线的奖励。最初的佐拉靴是由古代工匠为一位老国王制作的。在东湖水坝完工后，佐拉开始为前来探望的希尔人制作这些靴子，以表示友谊。洛法特给林克的佐拉靴是她在父亲的盔甲店里剩下的最后一对。

穿上佐拉靴会提升游泳速度。 还可以与剩余的佐拉套装（佐拉头盔和佐拉盔甲）一同使用，为林克提供游泳冲刺消耗体力加成。 它们可以被大仙增强，并在古驰染料店进行染色。
description_zh: 卓拉族代代相传的护胫。据说是拿龙鳞当作材料使用。装备后，能发挥加快游泳速度的效果。

name: Zora Helm
description: Zora headgear made from dragon scales. Increases swimming speed and allows you to spin to attack while swimming.
obtained_zh: “泽拉头盔”是一件可在托托湖找到的防具。佩戴后，链接将获得游泳速度加成，并可以在水中使用旋转攻击。 “泽拉头盔”、“泽拉防具”和“泽拉靴子”组成“泽拉套装”。 可以通过伟大的仙女强化或在科齐染料店染色。
description_zh: 卓拉族自古留传下来的头盔。据说使用龙鳞制成，可以提高游泳的速度。游泳时还能使出旋转攻击。
